abilities.name: Crush to Death
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
abilities.lore: Gobsprakk’s mount, Killabeak, takes wicked delight in crushing smaller foes in its talons.

abilities.name: Strangle Hex
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Coiling tendrils of magic burst from Gobsprakk’s outstretched hand, choking the life from the target.

abilities.name: Mork Sez No!
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster. If the unbinding roll was 10+, inflict D6 mortal damage on the caster instead.
abilities.lore: As enemy wizards foolishly attempt to weave their magics, Gobsprakk summons tapewyrm sguigs into their guts and fills their minds with so much Waaagh! energy that they sometimes explode!

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Killabeak’s Talons and Beak** is 5.

abilities.name: Screamin' Mandrakk
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.description: Effect: This unit uses the ‘Unbind’ ability but the unbinding roll is 3D6 instead of 2D6.
abilities.lore: The awful sound this plant emits wreaks havoc on the concentration of enemy wizards.

abilities.name: Vulcha Dive
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The Corpse-rippa crashes down into the enemy’s ranks from on high, tearing into reeling warriors with cruel relish.

abilities.name: Commanding View
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly Gutrippaz unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
abilities.lore: From his position high above the battlefield, a Killaboss riding a Corpse-rippa Vulcha can keep a careful eye on the battle, guiding the movements of their ladz.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Vulcha’s Talons and Beak** is 5.

abilities.name: All Part of Da Plan
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 3 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Kruleboyz tend to be very impressed by a Killaboss’s kunnin’ feats – so long as the boss has a plan, they are willing to face down even the most unlikely odds.

abilities.name: That's Ours, Ya Gitz!
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is contesting an objective you do not control, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Kruleboyz are raiders by nature, and the Killabosses are expert at getting the boyz all worked up when they see territory or loot that they’d love to get their dirty hands on.

abilities.name: Keep 'Em In Line
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘All-out Attack’ command for a friendly KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY unit
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of the unit using the ‘All-out Attack’ command, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by that unit for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: With a threatening glare and barked commands, the Killaboss keeps their boyz in formation.

abilities.name: Unleash the Stab-grot!
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

• Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

After resolving either effect, remove this unit’s **Stab-grot** from the battlefield.
abilities.lore: A Stab-grot isn’t just good for stabbin’ – they double up as an effective living shield when things get dicey.

abilities.name: Stab-grot
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Stab-grot** is a token. If this unit’s **Stab-grot** has been removed, it can no longer attack with its **Stab-grot’s Shiv** and it cannot use the ‘Unleash the Stab-grot!’ ability.

abilities.name: Tear Limb From Limb
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
abilities.lore: Mirebrute Troggoths take great delight plucking foes from the enemy ranks and pulling off their limbs one by one.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.

abilities.name: Breaka-harness
abilities.description:
Effect: Make a breaka-roll of D3.

•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on this unit equal to the breaka-roll.
•  Double the breaka-roll and add that value to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Mirebrute’s Clubs** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When a Breaka-boss enters combat, they yank their Mirebrute Troggoth’s harness savagely to get the beast good and angry!

abilities.name: Sludgeraker Venom
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: That unit has the **SLUDGERAKER VENOM** keyword for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The underbelly of a Sludgeraker Beast is coated in rotting detritus, encrusted marsh-slime and the beast’s own secretions – a highly virulent mixture that is used by nearby Kruleboyz to coat their weapons.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Sludgeraker’s Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: Festering Wounds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that had any damage points allocated to them this turn by attacks made by this unit or a friendly unit with the **SLUDGERAKER VENOM** keyword to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the end of the next turn.
abilities.lore: A Sludgeraker’s talons and fangs are so coated with toxins and grime that wounds they inflict swiftly turn foul and gangrenous.

abilities.name: Aggravate Wounds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The ornery and near-sighted Sloppklaw has developed a keen scent for weakness, and he will eagerly tear into wounded prey in a savage frenzy.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Sloppklaw’s Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: Kountin' Krew
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, the target’s **Slitta-knives** have **Crit (Mortal)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Swampboss Skumdrekk keeps his hobgrot lackeys, known as his ‘Kountin’ Krew’, close to hand. So close, in fact, that it is they who get first dibs on the toxic sludge that coats the underbelly of his Sludgeraker.

abilities.name: Bet-master
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be **the bet**.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit and friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** units that target **the bet**.
abilities.lore: Skumdrekk and his hobgrot Kountin’ Krew take bets at the start of a battle as to which of the enemy will be first to die.

abilities.name: Kompany Taktikz
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Slittabosses drill their hobgrots without mercy – after all, the more decisively they strike, the better chance they have of grabbing up the loot.

abilities.name: Toxic Stash
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: A Slittaboss’s swindling talents are used to secure choice poisons that can overwhelm even a stamping ogor.

abilities.name: Breath of the Mire-drakes
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 1, this ability has no effect. On a 2-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Belcha-bannas are typically built around the severed tongue of a mire-drake, creatures so vile that even after death, their remains belch forth clouds of soulshrivelling gas.

abilities.name: Power of Kragnos
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: When the energy of the Waaagh! hangs thick in the air, the Belcha-banna channels the mighty power of Kragnos himself, emboldening the Kruleboyz around it and warding off harmful sorcery.

abilities.name: Foul Elixirs
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Swampcalla Shamans brew up disgusting but life-saving elixirs, which they distribute to their Kruleboyz mates to aid them in battle.

abilities.name: Pot-grot
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Pot-grot** is a token. Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit while its **Pot-grot** is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less for this unit, remove its **Pot-grot** from the battlefield.
abilities.lore: This little grot is given the important role of ‘stirrin’ da pot’.

abilities.name: Scare Taktikz
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by non-**HERO** units that target this unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Gutrippaz use all manner of means to unnerve and soften up their foes before the first blow is struck, from gruesome ‘skareshields’ to ululating battle cries that echo from the boggy mists.

abilities.name: Scrap-bang
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: By detonating their scrap-grenades at the feet of the foe, Hobgrot Slittaz can scarper off to a safe distance.

abilities.name: Bait and Trap
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is damaged. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Monsta‑killaz have perfected the art of baiting even the most fearsome monsters into debilitating traps.

abilities.name: A Tough Grot To Swallow
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a RAMPAGE ability for an enemy MONSTER within 6" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, that **RAMPAGE** ability has no effect. On a 1, remove this unit’s **Klutcha-grot** from the battlefield.
abilities.lore: The spiky-armoured Klutcha-grot is usually gobbled up by the Monsta-killaz’ prey, causing it to choke, retch and vomit up the little git. Of course, sometimes the grot just gets eaten, which the orruks find equally hilarious.

abilities.name: Klutcha-grot
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Klutcha-grot** is a token. If it is removed from the battlefield, this unit cannot use the ‘A Tough Grot to Swallow’ ability.

abilities.name: Pick 'Em Off
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Boltboyz prefer to remain stationary to fire carefully aimed shots.

abilities.name: Man-skewer Crossbows
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, pick either the **Hasty Shot** or **Aimed Shot** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its **Man‑skewer Crossbows**.
abilities.lore: Boltboyz either unleash quick volleys at nearby foes or take careful aim at far-off targets.

abilities.name: Skewering Bolts
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Beast-skewer Bolts** is 6 if the target is a **MONSTER**.
abilities.lore: When sighting a particularly large target, the crew load vicious skewering bolts that can tear through even the mightiest of beasts.

abilities.name: Pick 'Em Off
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Once set up in position, the Beast-skewer Killbow takes its time to line up every shot with deadly results.

abilities.name: On Da March
abilities.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The drummer that rides with a snatcha-krew beats out a powerful rhythm upon his kettle drum that inspires the Kruleboyz around them to race headlong toward the enemy.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.

abilities.name: Avatar of Destruction
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Kragnos is the embodiment of Ghur’s relentless ferocity. No single strike can lay him low.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The** **Dread Mace** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilities.name: The End of Empires
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly **DESTRUCTION** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: Where Kragnos goes, the hordes of Destruction follow.

abilities.name: The Shield Inviolate
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.
abilities.lore: Tuskbreaker has the power to guard Kragnos against even the most potent magical force.

abilities.name: Rampaging Destruction
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).
abilities.lore: Kragnos rampages through the press of his foes, his hooves flattening all in his path.

abilities.name: Prowling the Flanks
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Killaboss lurks at the edges of the battle looking for weaknesses in the enemy’s lines.

abilities.name: Drag 'Em Out
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. Then, if possible, your opponent must remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Killaboss picks the toughest-looking git and has their Gnashtoof drag them away from their allies.

abilities.name: Just Keep Stabbin'
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:

• Add 1 to each roll.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The Killaboss angrily kicks their luckless Stab-grot towards an enemy, where the little git does what they do best.

abilities.name: Jump 'Em, Ladz, Or Else!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick a friendly **Gutrippaz** or **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Killaboss knows just how to motivate their boyz: threats, intimidation and a very real demonstration of what will happen to them if they don’t get stuck in.

abilities.name: Strength From Victory
abilities.description:
Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, give this unit a **Waaagh! token**, to a maximum of 3.

Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s weapons for each **Waaagh! token** it has.
abilities.lore: The more fights a Megaboss wins, the stronger they become.

abilities.name: Monster Grapple
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target’s weapons. You must pick a **Companion** weapon if it has any. Halve the Attacks characteristic of that weapon (rounding up) for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Gordrakk’s Maw-krusha, Bigteef, is strong and mean enough to wrestle even the most gigantic rivals into the dirt.

abilities.name: Voice of Gork
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a WAAAGH! ability
abilities.description: Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Gordrakk’s bellow carries the elemental force of his god; it inspires Ironjawz to surge toward the enemy, hacking, bludgeoning and stomping with furious abandon.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Bigteef’s Fists and Tail** is 6.

abilities.name: Destructive Bulk
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a D3. On a 2+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the D3 roll. If that enemy unit is **INFANTRY**, double the mortal damage inflicted.
abilities.lore: A Maw-krusha is an unstoppable avalanche of ill-tempered muscle that turns all in its path into pulverised meat.

abilities.name: Strength From Victory
abilities.description:
Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, give this unit a **Waaagh! token**, to a maximum of 3.

Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s weapons for each **Waaagh! token** it has.
abilities.lore: The more fights a Megaboss wins, the stronger they become.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Maw-krusha’s Fists and Tail** is 5.

abilities.name: Strength From Victory
abilities.description:
Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, give this unit a **Waaagh! token**, to a maximum of 3.

Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s weapons for each **Waaagh! token** it has.
abilities.lore: The more fights a Megaboss wins, the stronger they become.

abilities.name: Lead Da Brutes
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **BRUTE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Megabosses stride into battle flanked either side by the toughest and meanest Brutes.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Maw-grunta’s Tusks** is 3.

abilities.name: Head of the Stampede
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick up to 3 friendly **MAW‑GRUNTA** units wholly within 12" of this unit that charged this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 momentum point to each target.
abilities.lore: At the forefront of a grunta stampede rides the Tuskboss, racing to be the first to the fray.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Momentum
abilities.description:
Effect: Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a **CHARGE** ability, it gains 1 **momentum point**.

Each time it uses a **RUN** ability, it gains 2 **momentum points.** It can have a maximum of 3 **momentum points** at once.

Add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its **Maw-grunta’s Tusks.** At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its **momentum points**, to a minimum of 0.
abilities.lore: Once a Maw-grunta begins its charge, it can only stop by crashing into something, and it becomes ever more deadly as its speed increases.

abilities.name: Ward-smashing Choppa
abilities.description: Effect: If an attack made with this unit’s **Ward-smashing Choppa** scores a hit, the target has the **WARD‑SMASHED** keyword for the rest of the battle. Ward rolls cannot be made for a **WARD-SMASHED** unit even if this unit has been destroyed.
abilities.lore: A strike from this choppa shatters not only skulls but also arcane wards and other mystical forms of protection.

abilities.name: Power of Da Great Green God
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Make a forgin’ roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is armed with **Grunta-tongs**. On a 4+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Channelling the raw energies of the Waaagh! with his ‘bashin’ tools’, Zoggrok can empower the weapons of orruks gathered around him.

abilities.name: Klonk
abilities.description:
Effect: **Klonk** is a token. You can re-roll forgin’ rolls for this unit while this unit’s **Klonk** is on the battlefield. 

If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove this unit’s **Klonk** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).
abilities.lore: This rockbrow squig’s headache is only relieved by a bash on the head, making it the perfect portable anvil.

abilities.name: Get Bashin'!
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to shield bash rolls for friendly **Ardboyz** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Shields are made for krumping in the eyes of a Big Boss, who makes sure their boys are using them the ‘propa way’.

abilities.name: Iron-fisted Commander
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly **Ardboyz** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
abilities.lore: No Ardboy would dare quit the fight with the boss around.

abilities.name: Rhythm of Destruction
abilities.description: Effect: If any enemy models were slain this turn by this unit’s combat attacks, give this unit D3 ritual points.
abilities.lore: With each enemy skull caved in by the Warchanter’s Gorkstikk and Morkstikk, the febrile energy of the Waaagh! begins to build.

abilities.name: Brutal Power
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level while there are any friendly **IRONJAWZ** units that have 10 or more models wholly within 12" of it.
abilities.lore: A Weirdnob Shaman channels the Waaagh! energy emitted by nearby orruk mobs.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Make a shield bash roll of D6 for each model in this unit that is within 3" of the target. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The shields carried by Ardboyz are great slabs of iron festooned with spikes and metal teeth, making them deadly weapons in their own right.

abilities.name: You Messin'?
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units with a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: Most beings with half an ounce of common sense swiftly wither under the furious gaze of an orruk Brute who has marked their territory.

abilities.name: Berserkers
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
abilities.lore: These Brutes forego heavy armour, which means they can get stuck in to the fighting as quickly as possible.

abilities.name: Unleashed Rage
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Brute Ragerz waste no time in venting their pent-up rage when they get within striking distance of the foe.

abilities.name: Berserkers
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
abilities.lore: These Brutes forego heavy armour, which means they can get stuck in to the fighting as quickly as possible.

abilities.name: Gore-grunta Charge
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted (if any) if the target is **CAVALRY**.
abilities.lore: Even by the destructive standards of the Ironjawz, the carnage caused by a Gore-grunta charge is horrific to behold.

abilities.name: Carve a Path
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.

Then, pick each enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this unit gains 2 **momentum points**.
abilities.lore: The job of the hakkin’ krew is to clear a path through packed enemies to ensure the Maw-grunta maintains its momentum.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Momentum
abilities.description:
Effect: Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a **CHARGE** ability, it gains **1 momentum point**.

Each time it uses a **RUN** ability, it gains **2 momentum points**. It can have a maximum of **3 momentum points** at once.

Add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its **Maw-grunta’s Tusks**. At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its **momentum points**, to a minimum of 0.
abilities.lore: Once a Maw-grunta begins its charge, it can only stop by crashing into something, and it becomes ever more deadly as its speed increases.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Momentum
abilities.description:
Effect: Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a **CHARGE** ability, it gains **1 momentum point**.

Each time it uses a **RUN** ability, it gains **2 momentum points**. It can have a maximum of **3 momentum points** at once.

Add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its **Maw-grunta’s Tusks**. At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its **momentum points**, to a minimum of 0.
abilities.lore: Once a Maw-grunta begins its charge, it can only stop by crashing into something, and it becomes ever more deadly as its speed increases.

abilities.name: Flattened Into The Mud
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice and add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the roll. On a 5+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Should a foe miraculously survive the impact of a charging Maw-grunta, it will take some time for them to regather their wits!

abilities.name: Avatar of Destruction
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Kragnos is the embodiment of Ghur’s relentless ferocity. No single strike can lay him low.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The** **Dread Mace** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilities.name: The End of Empires
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly **DESTRUCTION** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: Where Kragnos goes, the hordes of Destruction follow.

abilities.name: The Shield Inviolate
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.
abilities.lore: Tuskbreaker has the power to guard Kragnos against even the most potent magical force.

abilities.name: Rampaging Destruction
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).
abilities.lore: Kragnos rampages through the press of his foes, his hooves flattening all in his path.

abilities.name: Get in There and Wallop 'Em!
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that was not set up this turn to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, when you use the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability, you can pick that friendly unit to be a second target.
abilities.lore: This Megaboss takes it as a personal affront if any of their ladz are not well and truly stuck in to the fighting.

abilities.name: You Ain't Gonna Show Me Up
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit used a **FIGHT** ability this turn, spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Boss-choppa** for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Should the first hit fail to lay the enemy low, the Megaboss will make sure the second does. And the third, and the fourth...

abilities.name: You Call Dat a Punch?
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted this unit
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: There’s nothing a Brute loves more than showing someone how much ’arder than them they are.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Soulpiercer** is 4.

abilities.name: Supernatural Grace
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Whether they turn blows aside or simply dodge out of harm’s way, it is extremely difficult to pin down a Keeper of Secrets.

abilities.name: Paramount Hunter
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a HERO within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can immediately move up to 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but it must end that move within ½" of that **HERO**. If it does so, this unit has charged, and that **HERO**’s **CHARGE** ability has no effect.
abilities.lore: Shalaxi will permit none save themselves the honour of striking down their chosen quarry.

abilities.name: An Exquisite Trophy
abilities.lore: Shalaxi Helbane delights in making examples of the enemy's greatest champions, redoubling their aggression to ensure victory and shatter enemy morale.

abilities.name: Refine Senses
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the casting roll if this unit is the target. 

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Shalaxi draws upon sensory magics to sharpen their followers' instincts and render them more decisive hunters.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Elegant Greatblade** is 3.

abilities.name: Supernatural Grace
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Whether they turn blows aside or simply dodge out of harm’s way, it is extremely difficult to pin down a Keeper of Secrets.

abilities.name: Locus of Slaanesh
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: With violence and excess, the walls of reality can be made thin enough to draw forth reinforcements of Slaaneshi daemons.

abilities.name: Cacophonic Choir
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick any number of visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Subtract 1 from the casting roll for each target you picked after the first.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
abilities.lore: The Keeper of Secrets unleashes a sanity-shattering chorus of magical sound.

abilities.name: Dark Temptations
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following musks. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn.

***Alluring Musk***:
• This unit’s weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for attacks that target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit.

***Psychotropic Musk***:
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit.
• Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: With a flourish and an ecstatic sigh, the Keeper of Secrets alters its scent to elicit the desired effect in its victims and plunge itself into a blissful state of combat euphoria.

abilities.name: Joyous Battle Fury
abilities.description: Effect: If any enemy models were slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Impaling Talons** for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Once Dexcessa begins to fight, they become invigorated by the glorious thrill of combat.

abilities.name: Fleeting Dance of Death
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it is in combat.
abilities.lore: Dexcessa rarely stays locked in combat in one place for long, flitting swiftly all over the battlefield and bringing death wherever they alight.

abilities.name: Redolence of Violence
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If this unit charged this turn, add 2 to the roll. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target is automatically slain. If the target is a **MANIFESTATION** and the roll exceeds its banishment value, it is banished.
abilities.lore: Should Dexcessa fall into a truly ecstatic rampage, very little can hope to survive the whirling, spiteful onslaught that they unleash – let alone remain in one piece.

abilities.name: You! Amuse Us!
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **PARAGON** that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range and visible to this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Cruel Dexcessa is patron to many warrior-champions, and they expect these favoured souls to prove their worth.

abilities.name: Whispers of Desire
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Synessa whispers words that reveal the enemy’s darkest urges, breaking their concentration and causing them to falter in their attack.

abilities.name: Enthralling Splendour
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit with a lower Control characteristic than this unit, that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A mere glance at Synessa’s magnificence leaves those nearby captivated.

abilities.name: Arcane Seductor
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is higher than the target’s power level, for the rest of the battle round, while the target is within 18" of this unit:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units while they are within 18" of this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.
abilities.lore: Those with some mystical aptitude are especially vulnerable to Synessa’s wiles; the Voice relishes unpicking their minds, working plots to steal their power for itself.

abilities.name: Captive Audience
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The Masque’s hypnotic movements make it nigh impossible for a viewer to focus their attention elsewhere.

abilities.name: The Endless Dance
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***The Dance of Dreaming***: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

***The Pavane of Slaanesh***: This unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

***The Waltz of Lethargy***: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use commands while it is in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The Masque is master of every breed of quickstep, pivot and sauté imaginable – and many that appear to defy both imagination and the limits of the flesh.

abilities.name: Champions of the Gilded Throne
abilities.description: Effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, instead of picking 1 unit, you can pick a friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit wholly within 18" of this unit and a friendly non-**HERO** **SYBARITE** unit wholly within 18" of this unit. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.
abilities.lore: Blessed by Syll’Esske, nearby daemons and mortals fight with a synergy that defies comprehension.

abilities.name: Unholy Symbiosis
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 1 visible friendly **SYBARITE** unit and up to 1 visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If you picked a **SYBARITE** target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by its combat attacks until the start of your next turn. If you picked a **DAEMON** target, it has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The dark enchantments woven by the twin entity Syll’Esske can offer power to both mortal and daemon alike – though there must always be a balance, a reflection of their own wicked union.

abilities.name: Violent Offerings
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points were allocated this turn by this unit’s combat attacks to an enemy **WIZARD**, **PRIEST**, **UNIQUE** unit or unit with an artefact of power, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Esske will go to great lengths to please Syll, delicately prising magical trinkets from the severed heads and limbs of the enemy to gift to the source of his obsession.

abilities.name: Gifts of Pain and Pleasure
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick either a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit or a visible enemy unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is a friendly unit, add 2" to its Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. If the target is an enemy unit, inflict **X** mortal damage on it, then **Heal (X)** this unit. **X** is equal to the number of models in this unit.
abilities.lore: When working in concert, the daemons of a Thricefold Discord can harness the magics of their chosen debaucheries to wrack enemies with torment or offer boons to diverting allies.

abilities.name: Thricefold Court
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects that you did not pick in the previous turn. The effect applies for the rest of the turn:

***Sins of Soul***: While an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** is visible to this unit, add 1 to this unit’s power level.

***Sins of Flesh***: This unit’s attacks score critical hits on unmodifed hit rolls of 5+.

***Sins of Mind***: Each time a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you receive 3 additional rally points.
abilities.lore: The daemons of a Thricefold Discord are exalted creatures, each steeped in a particular Sacred Seduction and determined to prove that its favoured sin is the most ensnaring.

abilities.name: Spell-Shredding Symphony
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** and **BANISH** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. In addition, each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster and each time this unit successfully banishes a **MANIFESTATION**, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit that summoned that **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: The vile tunes of torture strummed by these daemon-heralds are so unpalatable that even magic comes undone at their vibrations. So too, as it happens, do the casters.

abilities.name: Maestros of Discordance
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick another visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the enemy target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the enemy target.

Then, you can pick 1 of the following effects:
• **Heal (X)** the friendly target, where **X** is the number of enemy models slain by this ability this phase.
• Return a number of slain models to the friendly target unit with a total Health characteristic equal to or less than the number of enemy models slain by this ability this phase.
abilities.lore: An Infernal Enrapturess can play music so dissonant that it causes physical harm to enemies while captivating other daemonic entities beyond the veil of reality.

abilities.name: The Mirror's Depths
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.lore: When a warrior stares into a Contorted Epitome’s mirror, they see all their hopes and fears reflected there and cannot tear their eyes away.

abilities.name: Swallow Energy
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.lore: A Contorted Epitome’s mirror absorbs the most deep-seated conceits of those who look into it, channelling those fantasies back to Slaanesh’s Temple of Twisted Mirrors, where they can be blended into delicious torments.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Kyazu’s Greatblade and Mutants’ Claws** is 4.

abilities.name: Gorge on Excess
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYBARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: **Heal (6)** the target or return a number of slain models to the target with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
abilities.lore: Glutos’s followers grow strong on acts of gross indulgence.

abilities.name: Crippling Famishment
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• Halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
abilities.lore: With a snap of his fingers, Glutos afflicts his prey with debilitating hunger pangs that see them double over and stumble in bouts of sudden weakness.

abilities.name: Paragon of Gluttony
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following delicacies for Glutos to savour. You cannot pick a delicacy that you picked in the previous turn. The effect applies for the rest of the turn:

***Heart of a Shadow Daemon***: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-**MONSTER** **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

***Blood of an Aelven Princeling***: Each time a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **RUN** ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

***Crushed Incarnate’s Core***: Add 1 to unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit.

***Unspeakable Viscera***: Inflict D6 mortal damage on each other unit (friendly and enemy) within this unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: None embody gluttony better than Glutos, who is ever craving new, extreme and excessive delicacies.

abilities.name: Shardslash
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by this unit’s combat attacks.
abilities.lore: This majestic blade slices through armour and arcane wards alike as if they were the thinnest silk.

abilities.name: Gaze Upon My Magnificence and Weep
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will **adulate** or **reject** Sigvald.

***Adulate:*** Until the start of your next turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, it must pick this unit to be the target of pile-in moves it makes.

***Reject:*** Inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target, then **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points inflicted on the target this turn by this ability.
abilities.lore: It is said that to look upon Sigvald is to have one’s mind stolen. Those who resist are cut down by outraged fellows – much to the petulant prince’s delight.

abilities.name: Paragon of Vainglory
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit charged this turn and the unmodified charge roll was 6+ , for the rest of the turn:

• This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
• The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Shardslash** is equal to the unmodified charge roll.
• Melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by other friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
abilities.lore: Sigvald is the epitome of vainglory, one of Slaanesh’s favourite sins. So great is his sense of superiority that few can stand before his prideful assaults.

abilities.name: Slaughterous Celebrants
abilities.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit, melee weapons used by friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
abilities.lore: Those Hedonites who follow a Lord of Hysteria have been stoked into such an inferno of depraved and mindless revelry that to approach them is to be dragged into a pit of wild, slavering animals and soon ripped to shreds.

abilities.name: Master of the Revels
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick a visible friendly **SYBARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is a **PARAGON**, apply the following effect to the target. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effect to the target:

• For the rest of the turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Empowered by the lordly daemon that shares their soul, a Lord of Hysteria knows many means by which to inspire a wild frenzy in their followers.

abilities.name: Veiled Threat
abilities.description: Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **waiting in ambush**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: Slaangors can move as smoothly and soundlessly as silk before bursting out into a bleating, bellowing charge.

abilities.name: Bestial Onslaught
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **waiting in ambush**.

Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: With primal savagery, the Slaangor Fiendbloods take to the battlefield, ready to surround their enemies.

abilities.name: Instinctive Advance
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can move 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.
abilities.lore: The Slaangors are drawn to the screams of the battlefield as a hungering predator is drawn to wounded prey.

abilities.name: False Serenity
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has not charged this turn, it has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Myrmidesh take pains to appear unflappable.

abilities.name: Dance of the Wailing Blade
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: The Myrmidesh are masters of a martial form known as the Dance of the Wailing Blade – a sword-kata that emphasises quick, cruel and painful counter-attacks.

abilities.name: Pah! Unworthy!
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is damaged or has fewer than half its starting models, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Seeing other possessed warriors fall merely convinces surviving Symbaresh of their own superiority.

abilities.name: Ego-Driven Excess
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has a higher Control characteristic than this unit.
abilities.lore: The Symbaresh have twisted their very souls in the hope of standing paramount amongst warriors. Nothing infuriates them more, therefore, than the sight of a potentially worthy rival.

abilities.name: Unrivalled Velocity
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll the charge roll.
abilities.lore: Slickblade Seekers are obsessed with high-speed kills, tearing towards the foe with relentless haste.

abilities.name: Blissbrew Homonculus
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Blissbrew Homonculi** are tokens. There is 1 **Blissbrew Homonculus** for every 10 models in this unit.

This unit has **WARD (6+)** while it has any **Blissbrew Homonculi**. If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of this unit’s **Blissbrew Homonculi** from the battlefield (the damage point is still inflicted).
abilities.lore: These imps carry censers that belch sickly incense that tricks the senses and blinds hostile eyes.

abilities.name: The Thrill of Combat
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit’s ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat** and they also have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for attacks that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: The sensory bombardment of a nearby melee gives the Blissbarbs a heady surge of adrenaline, heightening their reactions and the accuracy of their bowfire.

abilities.name: Lithe and Swift
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, it can move D3+3". It can pass through enemy models and the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit.
abilities.lore: Daemonettes move so fast that the mortal eye almost cannot follow; they vault, twirl and leap through enemy ranks like some marvellous troupe of performers, though their laughter soon turns savage as their claws go to work.

abilities.name: Quicksilver Speed
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn, it can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: The thrill of the chase is everything to the daemonic Seekers; if no prey lies before them, their steeds will simply keep powering onwards, tongues flicking out as they search for soul- traces of new, enticing quarry.

abilities.name: Arcane Disruption
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and unbinding rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Fiends of Slaanesh let out a keening chorus that shreds the sanity of spellcasters who hear it.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Disharmonious Song
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit that did not use a **CHARGE** or **FIGHT** ability this turn to be a target.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. You can re-roll the dice if the target is a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The trilling song of the Fiends is hideous to perceive, breaking and twisting the mind. For those with arcane gifts or a divine connection, it is even more excruciating.

abilities.name: Bargain with the Mist-Daemons
abilities.phase: Once per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict 2 mortal damage on this unit. On a 3+, add 2 to the casting roll.
abilities.lore: The entities bound into the mists that surround a Shardspeaker can offer power – but one must take caution in dealing with such spiteful creatures...

abilities.name: Truths of the Twisted Mirror
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is a **PARAGON**, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.
abilities.lore: When flushed with the favour of Slaanesh, a Shardspeaker can use their sorcerous ability and cursed mirror to show an enemy a reflection of their darkest and most unspeakable desires, lowering their guard at a crucial moment.

abilities.name: Atrocious Ministrations
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: You can allocate 1 damage point to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: To be the subject of a Lord of Pain’s monstrous arts is always energising for a true Hedonite – provided they survive the experience…

abilities.name: Share The Pain
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** while it is in combat. In addition, each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit for a damage point inflicted by a combat attack, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Lords of Pain have mastered every kind of torment; they shrug off agony as if it were nothing, all while doling out the same hideous sensations to their foes.

abilities.name: Allow Me To Demonstrate
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit and the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: For all their boasting and crushing arrogance, Lords of Hubris truly are astounding to behold in combat – a fact that inevitably galvanises their devoted sycophants.

abilities.name: You First, I Insist...
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will **accept** or **decline** this unit’s challenge:

If they **accept**, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks and all of the target’s attacks must target this unit.

If they **decline**, for the rest of the turn:
• The target has **STRIKE-LAST**.
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: So confident is this champion of excess that they allow their foe a futile swipe for free.

abilities.name: Adrenaline Archers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities this turn even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, for the rest of the turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Blissbarb Seekers live in such a heightened sensory state that enemies seem to move in slow motion; they weave to and fro through the most vicious combats, loosing arrows all the while.

abilities.name: Numbing Toxins
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: The target cannot use reactions or be picked to be the target of reactions used by your opponent or by units in your opponent’s army for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Some Blissbarbs dip their arrows in substances that deprive those they strike of sensation, dulling their reactions.

abilities.name: Prophet of the Horned Rat
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll chanting rolls for this unit until the start of your next turn
abilities.lore: Vizzik endlessly schemes to extend his god's influence - alongside his own.

abilities.name: The Death Frenzy
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13"of this unit or a visible friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the target is an enemy unit, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

If the target is a friendly unit, it can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick 2 targets instead of 1.
abilities.lore: Such is the force of Vizzik's screeching oratory that the verminous hordes froth and spasm under his influence as mere mortals unravel to visions of their inevitable doom.

abilities.name: Gaze of the Gnaw
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn:

• If this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, all of the target's attacks must target this unit.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's combat attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: To catch Vizzik's gaze is to be driven from one's mind by agonising raptures.

abilities.name: Fissures In Reality
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Those who resist Vizzik's will are swallowed by fang-mouthed fissures that wrench open in his presence.

abilities.name: Boneripper Rampage
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3-5, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Thanquol’s monstrous Rat Ogor, Boneripper, pulverises enemies that dare stray too close.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpfire Braziers** is 4.

abilities.name: Terrible Madness
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target cannot use commands until the start of your next turn. In addition, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Thanquol can inflict madness on his enemies, causing them to lash out at close allies.

abilities.name: Warp-amulet
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Thanquol wears a thrumming green warpstone amulet, the mutating magics of which serve to meld and rapidly heal his, or Boneripper’s, flesh.

abilities.name: Staff of the Horned Rat
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
abilities.lore: Said to be crafted from scrap thieved from the Horned Rat’s lair, Thanquol’s staff thrums with malign potency.

abilities.name: The Dreaded Thirteenth Spell
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll 13 dice. For each 5+:

• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• You can return 1 slain model to a friendly **Clanrats** unit wholly within 13" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The twisting power of the Great Horned Rat transforms men into rat-mutants that swiftly join the evil throng.

abilities.name: Terrifying Monstrosity
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
• Subtract an amount equal to the roll from the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Lord Skreech has a malevolent and horrific visage that can shatter the enemy’s resolve.

abilities.name: The Thirteen-headed One
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. You cannot pick the same effect more than once per battle.

***Master of Dire Sorcery:*** Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **MASTERCLAN WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Commander of Vermin:*** Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **VERMINUS** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Knower of Warp-tech:*** Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **SKRYRE** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Deliverer of Weeping Blades:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **ESHIN** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Bringer of Plagues:*** Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly **PESTILENS PRIESTS** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Shaper of Fleshcraft:*** **Heal (D3)** each friendly **MOULDER** unit wholly within 13" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Lord Verminking can call upon his extensive knowledge of the Skaven clans.

abilities.name: Burst From The Shadows
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can pick a point on the battlefield within 13" of this unit and within 1" of any enemy units. Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of that point.

**Designer’s Note:** *This ability allows the unit to set up in combat with a new enemy unit.*
abilities.lore: A Verminlord Deceiver is shrouded in darkness and dread, leaping through the aether to strike at its foes in the blink of an eye.

abilities.name: Lord of Assassins
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly ESHIN INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
abilities.lore: The skulking warriors of the Clans Eshin move like swift smoke in a Verminlord Deceiver’s presence.

abilities.name: Tyrant of Battle
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **VERMINUS INFANTRY** units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: The targets can each use the ‘All-out Attack’ or ‘All-out Defence’ command this phase even if that command has been used by a friendly unit this phase.
abilities.lore: These towering monstrosities are the commanders of the seething hordes of Clans Verminus.

abilities.name: Killing Blow
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a damaged enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of damage points the target has, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Warbringers drive their spike-fists into already wounded enemies, exploiting the slightest gap in their foe’s defences to deliver a bloody coup de grâce.

abilities.name: Plaguemaster
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Give this unit 1 ritual point.
abilities.lore: Hideous parasites and diseases made flesh spill from a Verminlord Corruptor to spread their sickness.

abilities.name: Lord of Great Plagues
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: If the unmodified chanting roll for a friendly **PESTILENS PRIEST** this phase was 6, pick 1 of the following effects to apply:

***Crimsonweal Curse:*** Pick an enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the battle, each time the target uses a **MOVE** ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on it after the **MOVE** ability has been resolved.

***The Neverplague:*** For the rest of the battle, you can re-roll chanting rolls for friendly **PESTILENS PRIESTS**.

***Undulant Scourge:*** Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target. Inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: If the raving prayers of Pestilens priests reach fever pitch across the battlefield, the Verminlord Corruptor can cause one of the legendary Great Plagues to temporarily manifest.

abilities.name: Arch-Manipulator
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Those who dare face a Warpseer find themselves utterly pre-empted and outmanoeuvred.

abilities.name: Tectonic Splintering
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
abilities.lore: Hissing invocations of ruin and collapse, the Verminlord compels the earth to break and belch forth hostile warpgales, leaving their enemies staggering.

abilities.name: Hurl Scry-orb
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Divine the Future’ ability for the rest of the battle. Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The Warpseer throws its scry-orb into the midst of the foe, where it explodes in a shattering cloud of madness and destruction.

abilities.name: Divine The Future
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is on the battlefield, add 2" to the distance friendly units can move when using the ‘Always Three Clawsteps Ahead’ ability.
abilities.lore: The swirling scry-orbs of the Warpseer can show it glimpses of the future.

abilities.name: Warpstone Shards
abilities.description:
Effect: The next time you make a casting roll for this unit this phase, roll 3D6 instead of 2D6. This roll cannot be rerolled or modified.

If the casting roll is 13, the spell is successfully cast and cannot be unbound. After the effect of that spell has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

If the casting roll is not 13, remove 1 dice of your choice from the casting roll and use the remaining 2D6 as the casting roll.
abilities.lore: Grey Seers consume potentially lethal shards of warpstone to enhance their spellcasting.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Bulk** is 4.

abilities.name: Peal of Doom
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:

**1 - *Magical Backlash***
Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

**2-4 - *Wall of Unholy Sound***
Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are within 13" of this unit.

**5-6 - *Apocalyptic Doom***
Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 13" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The ominous tolling of a Screaming Bell resounds above the clamour of battle, crying out ‘Doom! Doom! Doom!’

abilities.name: Cracks Call
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and is within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the casting roll exceeds the target’s Move characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the casting roll and its Move characteristic.
abilities.lore: Harnessing the thunderous peals of the Screaming Bell, the Grey Seer channels a sorcerous blast into the ground beneath the foe’s feet. Gaping chasms yawn wide, sending screaming victims vanishing into the depths.

abilities.name: Altar of the Horned Rat
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Throngs of rat-thralls swarm around this mighty construct in battle and will sell their lives to see it from harm.

abilities.name: Doomfang
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn but it cannot use commands this phase.
abilities.lore: Though Doomfang offers the ageing Krittok martial power, he must constantly haggle with its daemonic occupant, a fact that can sometimes prove distracting.
