abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, it can move **X**", where **X** is the number of **fate points** you have. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
abilities.lore: Willing pawns in the Change God’s schemes, Kairic Acolytes are driven by the winds of fate to wherever they can cause the most bloodshed and confusion.

abilities.name: Silver Monoliths
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Argent Shard**.
abilities.lore: The Jade Obelisk draw power from Argent Shards to augment their defence, seeing them as sacred monuments to their deity’s glory.

abilities.name: Idolarc
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Idolarc** is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its **Idolarc** next to it.
abilities.lore: Fashioned from crystal and given life by dark ritual, Idolarcs are the messengers of the Speaker in the Stone.

abilities.name: Chosen by the Stone
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has any models carrying an **Antithete Bow**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, place the **Idolarcs** of all other friendly **Jade Obelisk** units next to their respective units. Then, place this unit’s **Idolarc** next to the target.

While a friendly **Idolarc** is next to an enemy unit, subtract 1" from that enemy unit’s Move characteristic for each **fate point** you have. This ability cannot reduce an enemy unit’s Move characteristic below half its unmodified value.
abilities.lore: The Jade Obelisk loose a cursed arrow at a chosen foe, marking them out to the Idolarc as a potential sacrifice to the Speaker in the Stone that must be detained.

abilities.name: A Twisted Fate
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit must be deployed using this ability

Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **masked by illusion**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: For some, their destiny is to become a mewling abomination – they just do not know it yet.

abilities.name: Waves of Mutation
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit or the replacement of this unit is destroyed, set up a replacement unit in reserve **masked by illusion.** Each friendly **Chaos Spawn of Tzeentch** unit can be replaced any number of times.
abilities.lore: There is no limit to Tzeentch’s appetite for change.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Imperilling Slashes
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Screamers’ sharp fins and horns slice apart shields and armour as if they were parchment, leaving the foe vulnerable to attack.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Thaumaturge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **ARCANITE** unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target and in combat. This unit has charged.
abilities.lore: With a sweep of its staff, the Thaumaturge steps into a rift to the Crystal Labyrinth, only to re-emerge in the midst of foes who have had the temerity to assault its devotees.

abilities.name: Soul-Deep Devotion
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is within a friendly non‐**HERO ARCANITE** unit’s combat range:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Thaumaturges surround themselves with staunchly faithful cultists who are willing to sacrifice their souls in the defence of their sorcerous idol.

abilities.name: Hand of Dust
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: Nagash’s touch can turn a foe to a pile of dusty bones in moments.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Nagash is the undisputed master of all undead creatures.

abilities.name: The Staff of Power
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.
abilities.lore: Alakanash is capped with gems of purest grave-sand.

abilities.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: In a storm of morbid sorcery, Nagash blasts his foes’ souls or re-knits his minions’ bodies.

abilities.name: Aviarch Spymaster
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Aviarch Spymaster can use their spy network to disrupt the plans of Katakros’s enemies.

abilities.name: You Dare?!
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if at least half of the units from your starting army have been destroyed.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round:
• Add 5 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Inda-Khaat**.
• Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **The Shield Immortis**.
• This unit cannot use the 'Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions' ability.
abilities.lore: Katakros narrows his focus to personally deal with a more immediate threat.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit that is in combat and has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to be the target.

Effect: Spend a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the target's Health characteristic. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend an additional **relentless discipline** point. The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn. In addition, the target cannot use **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** abilities for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: An Ossiarch force personally led by Katakros is said to be worth ten identical forces led by his generals.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the number after its **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** keyword is 4.

abilities.name: Mortarch of the Necropolis
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units that have used any **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** abilities this turn.
abilities.lore: As master of the Ossiarchs, Katakros instils in his legions the insatiable will to conquer and extend his dominion.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Razarak’s Ebon Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Mortarch of Sacrament
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability for a unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound, its effect is not resolved and that **SPELL** ability cannot be used by enemy units until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Arkhan the Black is the master of the Null Myriad and privy to some of the most powerful mystical secrets in existence.

abilities.name: Curse of Years
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 6:

• Give the target 1 **necrotic withering** point.
• Roll an extra dice.

For each 5+ on those extra dice, repeat the above bullet points, Then, do the same for each 4+ and then each 3+. Finally, for each 2+, give the target 1 **necrotic withering** point (do not roll any extra dice).

After a roll, if the target has 8 or more **necrotic withering** points, it is automatically destroyed. Otherwise, after the last roll, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of **necrotic withering** points it has. Then, those **necrotic withering** points are lost.
abilities.lore: Tracing a spiteful gesture in the air, Arkhan curses the enemy to age at an incredible rate.

abilities.name: The Doom of Traitors
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST.** On a 2+, add an amount equal to the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Razarak's Ebon Claws** for the rest of the phase, but while this unit is in combat with the target, all attacks made with that weapon this phase must target that enemy unit.

**Designer's Note:** *If the target is a* **WIZARD** *or* **PRIEST,** *this ability cannot fail; however, you still need to roll to determine the number of extra attacks it generates.*
abilities.lore: The dread abyssal Razarak bears Arkhan into battle, seeking out those who have stoked the ire of the Great Necromancer.

abilities.name: The Staff of Spirits
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. Each time this unit successfully casts a spell, **Heal (1)** this unit after that **SPELL** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Khenash-an, the Staff of Spirits, grants Arkhan the power to absorb the souls of his foes.

weapons.name: Kavalos Steed’s Hooves, Teeth and Barbed Tails

abilities.name: Still Their Breath!
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS CAVALRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If this unit is in combat, no **relentless discipline** points are spent. The target's melee weapons have **Charge (+ 1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Such is Zandtos’s disdain for those who trespass in Shyish that those who fight beside him come to share it.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Charge
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.

Effect: The targets have **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Where Zandtos drives his attack home, enemy formations crumble and counter-attacks stall.

abilities.name: Voice of Nagash
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any **non-CORE** abilities used by other enemy units for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The sheer force of Vokmortian’s oratory fills even the boldest commanders with doubt.

abilities.name: Mortal Contract
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use a **CORE** ability, roll a D3 as a reaction. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **CORE** ability.
abilities.lore: Vokmortian binds an enemy to a deadly mystical contract.

weapons.name: Kavalos Steed’s Hooves, Teeth and Barbed Tails

abilities.name: Deathrider Commander
abilities.description: Effect: This unit and visible friendly **Kavalos Deathriders** units wholly within 12" of this unit can move 12" instead of 10" when they use the 'Deathrider Wedge' ability.
abilities.lore: A Liege-Kavalos's force of will drives the undead cavalry they command onwards without pause.

abilities.name: Master of Cavalry
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Kavalos Deathriders** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Liege‑Kavalos rides at the very tip of the cavalry spearhead, driving deep into the enemy’s vitals and smashing open a breach for their Deathriders to exploit.

abilities.name: Grind Them to Dust
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly **Kavalos War Chariots** wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: With a barked command, the Liege-Kavalos orders their fellow charioteers to press further into the melee and crush the foe beneath their wheels.

abilities.name: Masterful Charioteer
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat and has charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly **Kavalos War Chariots** that have charged this turn, that are wholly within 12" of this unit and that are in combat to be the targets.

Effect: Each target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As they plough through the enemy's ranks, the Liege-Kavalos leads the War Chariots in complex manoeuvres that prevent the foe from landing telling blows.

abilities.name: Clinical Efficiency
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase, Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit.
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick a visible friendly **Mortek Guard, Mortek Triaxes** or **Mortek Crawler** unit that has not used an **ATTACK** ability this phase and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use either a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase or a **FIGHT** ability. If it is picked to do so:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.
• The target's ranged weapons (if any) have **Shoot in Combat** for the rest of the turn.
• If the target uses a **SHOOT** ability and is not in combat, all of its shooting attacks must target units in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: With a sharp gesture, the Liege-Mortek orders his cohorts to unleash a deadly assault.

abilities.name: Legion Quartermaster
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
abilities.lore: Though not quartermasters in the traditional sense, Boneshapers are without peer when it comes to reassembling their line warriors from splintered remains.

abilities.name: Boneshaper
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **Mortek Guard** or **Mortek Triaxes** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat.
abilities.lore: The Boneshaper uses their arcane arts to form shattered bones into new Ossiarch constructs.

abilities.name: Necrotic Blast
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. After this ability has been resolved, you gain a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the number of total damage points allocated by this ability this turn.
abilities.lore: The Soulreaper sends a surge of deathly energy across the battlefield that can see nearby foes wracked with soul deep agony.

abilities.name: Soulreaper
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The mere presence of a Soulreaper will sap a foe’s strength, leaving them weak and vulnerable.

abilities.name: Soul-guide
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Soulmason empowers and focuses the souls that animate a nearby regiment of Ossiarch warriors.

abilities.name: Refined Creations
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **Mortek Crawler, Gothizzar Harvester, Morghast Archai** or **Morghast Harbingers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Ossifectors are always looking to improve upon their work, wielding necrotic sorcery to augment their creations in battle.

abilities.name: Scything Assault
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.
abilities.lore: The War Chariot's incredible momentum sees it crash straight through the enemy front lines with shocking force.

abilities.name: Pinning Attacks
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Liege-Kavalos on War Chariot**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Whether by javelin, arrow or sheer terror, the victims of the Kavalos War Chariot find themselves rooted in place.

abilities.name: Deathrider Wedge
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **Liege-Kavalos** within this unit's combat range to be the friendly target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy target. Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the enemy target if you picked a friendly target. Then, this unit and the friendly target (if any) can move 10". They can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The Kavalos Deathriders plunge through the enemy ranks, slashing as they quickly disengage before a reeling enemy can mount a defence.

abilities.name: Shields of the Legion
abilities.phase: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an **ATTACK** ability that targeted a visible **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit within this unit's combat range
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability that target any friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units within this unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: The Mortek Guard are the backbone of the Ossiarch legions, preventing enemy assaults from finding purchase wherever their nadirite shields are raised in tireless defence.

abilities.name: Bone-deep Savagery
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can move 3 ". If it can move into combat, it must. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The impure materials used in the creation of the Teratic Cohort has lent them an innate savagery that is all but impossible to truly control in the heat of battle.

abilities.name: Hunters Unleashed
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: Unable to hold back any longer, these feral constructs rush forward to engage their prey.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Atavistic Nightmares
abilities.description:
Effect: While any of this unit's **Balefire Braziers** are next to an enemy unit, subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units within that enemy unit's combat range.

If an ability would heal or return slain models to an enemy unit while any of this unit's **Balefire Braziers** are next to it, that ability does not heal or return any slain models to it. Instead, place those **Balefire Braziers** next to this unit.
abilities.lore: The trauma of the burning soul-essence is so horrifying that those who witness it are paralysed by dread.

abilities.name: Balefire Braziers
abilities.description: Effect: This unit's **Balefire Braziers** are tokens. There are 2 **Balefire Braziers** for every 10 models in this unit. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its **Balefire Braziers** next to it.
abilities.lore: These cauldrons are filled with tormented, blazing soul-matter with which the Triaxes augment their ammunition.

abilities.name: Cursed Flames
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit and this unit has any **Balefire Braziers** next to it, place 1 of those **Balefire Braziers** next to that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: As the Mortek Triaxes set foes ablaze, the tortured flames seek out other souls, and the panic spreads...

abilities.name: Necrocaches
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this unit can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The Mortis Reapers hurl their necrocaches to the ground, releasing the flesh-withering grave-sand contained within and vanishing in the resulting cloud like phantoms.

abilities.name: No Escaping the Tithe
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If there are no enemy units within 6" of this unit, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Mortis Reapers are utterly unrelenting in their pursuit of those who would dare attempt to shirk the bone-tithe.

abilities.name: Immortal Bulwark
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As the immovable shieldwall of the Ossiarch legions, the Immortis Guard can stand fast against any foe, no matter how vicious or savage.

abilities.name: Fourfold Slayers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If this unit has 3 or more models, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+ instead.
abilities.lore: Stalkers lethally wade into the fray, their fourfold quadrarch masks allowing them to attack from several directions at once and annihilate even massed opponents with chilling indifference.

abilities.name: Discharge Armour
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Morghast releases the arcane energy in their armour to overpower nearby magic users.

abilities.name: Ebon-wrought Armour
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (3+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.
abilities.lore: The Morghast’s armour is threaded with spells that protect them against arcane assault.

abilities.name: Harbingers of Death
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: Morghast Harbingers hurl themselves at the foe with unbridled ferocity.

abilities.name: Bone Harvest
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit that has been destroyed this battle. Add 1 to each roll if this unit used a **FIGHT** ability this turn. If any of the rolls are a 4+, this unit is **full.**
abilities.lore: As a Gothizzar Harvester fights, its vestigial appendages ceaselessly work to amass a grisly stockpile of bones.

abilities.name: Repair Construct
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is **full,** pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target has a Health characteristic of 1 return 3 slain models to it instead. Then, this unit is **empty.**
abilities.lore: The Harvester uses a portion of its morbid crop to restore the forms of fellow Ossiarchs.

abilities.name: Bone Cage
abilities.description: Effect: This unit is either **full** or **empty.** It starts the battle **full.**
abilities.lore: Tasked with collecting and flensing the corpses of the recently slain, Gothizzar Harvesters carry their osseous bounty inside the cages on their backs.

abilities.name: Cursed Stele
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn {Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• This unit's ranged weapons have **Anti-FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend).**
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's ranged weapons for attacks that target faction terrain features.
abilities.lore: As these carven polyhedrons obliterate the foe, rendering their remains unusable, the ever-practical Ossiarchs have begun to use this ammunition to breach enemy fortifications instead.

abilities.name: Deathly Barrage
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Mortisan Ossifector**, and add 1 to the roll if any other friendly **Mortek Crawlers** picked that enemy unit to be the target of all of their shooting attacks this turn. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The grisly ammunition of a Mortek Crawler can leave even the most stoic souls staggering.

abilities.name: Cowed Into Inaction
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time an enemy unit within the target’s combat range uses a command, unless your opponent spends 1 **rage dice** to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are lost.
abilities.lore: Temporarily possessing and channelling his voice through a nearby enemy warlord, Vokmortian intimidates their warriors until they are paralysed with fear.

abilities.name: Master of the Bone-Tithe
abilities.description:
Effect: Your opponent must pick 1 of the following effects:

***Pay the Tithe:*** Your opponent must pick a unit in their army on the battlefield to be the target. They cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** Or terrain feature. Then:
• Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.
• Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot be healed, have slain models returned to it or be replaced.

***Deny the Ossiarchs their Rightful Due:*** Pick 1 of the following effects:
• You gain 4 **relentless discipline** points.
• Pick an objective you do not control. For the rest of the turn, add 5 to the control scores of friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units while they are contesting that objective.
• For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic and add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's **Gaze of Death**.
abilities.lore: To reject Vokmortian’s demands is folly, yet to acquiesce to them involves no small degree of sacrifice...

abilities.name: The Coldness of Death
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If an enemy **HERO** was destroyed by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, your opponent must reduce their **fury level** to 0.
abilities.lore: By taking down the enemy’s greatest warriors, so too do the Mortis Reapers sap them of their battle fury.

abilities.name: Terminate Their Command
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is more than 3" from all other enemy units, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.
abilities.lore: Creeping unseen through the enemy ranks, the Mortis Reapers quickly close in on their real target.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilities.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: In a storm of morbid sorcery, Nagash blasts his foes’ souls or re-knits his minions’ bodies.

abilities.name: The Staff of Power
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.
abilities.lore: Alakanash is capped with gems of purest grave-sand.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Hand of Dust
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: Nagash’s touch can turn a foe to a pile of dusty bones in moments.

abilities.name: Trail of Crimson
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can make a pile-in move (even if it is not in combat). Then, if this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Shordemaire ploughs into the enemy’s lines, its giant jaws tearing huge chunks from monsters or swallowing smaller foes whole.

abilities.name: Saint of Slaughter
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER VAMPIRE** unit that destroyed a unit this turn using a **FIGHT** ability and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle:

• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

More than 1 effect can apply to a unit at the same time; however, each effect can only be applied to a unit once.
abilities.lore: Under the fierce scrutiny of Prince Vhordrai, vampires revel in displaying their martial skill.

abilities.name: Quickblood
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Vhordrai calls upon the power of the curse running through his veins to strike with impossible speed.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Shordemaire’s Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: The Mortarch of Blood
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY** or **DEADWALKERS INFANTRY** units to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: Neferata has millennia of experience analysing and unpicking her foes’ ploys.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Nagadron’s Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Dark Mist
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**MONSTER SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Neferata summons tendrils of penumbral mist to coil around her minions, rendering their corporeal forms as insubstantial as smoke.

abilities.name: The Adevore
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** that was allocated any damage points inflicted by this unit’s **Akmet-har** this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: Should Nagadron sense the impending doom of a foe wounded by the Dagger of Jet, it will fall upon them and hungrily feast on their soul.

abilities.name: Twilight's Allure
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Neferata cloaks her minions in perpetual gloom.

weapons.name: Gheistvor, the Sword of Unholy Power

abilities.name: Ashigaroth's Hunger
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit has **STRIKE‑FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Mannfred’s dread abyssal is afflicted by a hunger as indiscriminate as it is unending, and it strikes with lightning-fast speed to attempt in vain to satiate that hunger.

abilities.name: Wind of Death
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of the caster, pick up to 3 enemy units within 6" of that point and visible to the caster to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Mannfred conjures a howling gust of spectral wind that tears the souls from the bodies of those who feel its chilling bite.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Ashigaroth’s Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: The Mortarch of Night
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: The unit using the ‘Redeploy’ command can move into combat when using that ability.
abilities.lore: Mannfred’s ancient cunning is rightly feared throughout the Mortal Realms.

abilities.name: The Sword of Unholy Power
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has slain any enemy models this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Gheistvor drinks deep of its victims’ souls, bolstering the power of Mannfred’s risen minions.

abilities.name: Impaling Talons
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Lauka Vai thrusts her massive talons into her prey with lethal precision, inflicting horrendous wounds upon them.

abilities.name: Nightmare's Miasma
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The strange curse of the Vengorians sees shining blades and hallowed relics crumble and patinate in their presence.

abilities.name: The Queen's Dictat
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**UNIQUE SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS MONSTER** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. If the target has any **Companion** melee weapons, you must pick 1 of those. Add D3 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Lauka summons an arcane blood-mist that drives a beast among her brood into a terrible frenzy.

abilities.name: Festering Feast
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points were allocated to enemy units by this unit’s attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit and each other friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Vengorians bid their monstrous broods indulge in gory feasts even as battle rages.

abilities.name: Scything Talons
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: As the Vengorian Lord crashes into the foe, it lays about itself with frenzied sweeps of its huge talons, cutting down droves of lesser foes.

abilities.name: Nightmare's Miasma
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The strange curse of the Vengorians sees shining blades and hallowed relics crumble and patinate in their presence.

abilities.name: The Time-Swallower's Maw
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Serpentine Agility’ ability for the rest of the battle. Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Move characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the roll and its Move characteristic.
abilities.lore: Though Sekhar is loath to let Ouboroth feast upon souls, sometimes, needs must.

abilities.name: Death's Construction
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while they are wholly within 6" of this unit, friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** units cannot be picked to be the target of abilities used by the target other than **FIGHT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Through the subtlest arcane suggestion, Sekhar implants her will in vulnerable minds – supplanting their former purpose with the undying will of Nulahmia.

abilities.name: Serpentine Agility
abilities.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
abilities.lore: Sekhar moves as a blinding blur, her unnatural speed obscuring her form from even the keenest gaze.

abilities.name: The Beast Will Out
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can move D6". It can move into combat.
abilities.lore: In his hulking bestial form, Radukar is a frenzied abomination concerned only with tearing apart everything in his path.

abilities.name: Call to the Hunt
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: With an exultant howl, Radukar leads the charge, his surge of bloodlust filling nearby undead minions with unholy impetus.

abilities.name: Armour of the Night
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: With a mere thought, Radukar the Beast summons wisps of pure darkness to form a penumbral shield around his body, protecting him from harm.

abilities.name: Master of the Pack
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: His voice redolent with supernatural power, Radukar the Wolf barks the command to charge and his undead minions hurl themselves at the enemy.

abilities.name: Call to the Hunt
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: With an exultant howl, Radukar leads the charge, his surge of bloodlust filling nearby undead minions with unholy impetus.

abilities.name: Behemoth's Bane
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 2 from the Attacks characteristic of enemy **MONSTERS’** melee weapons while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: Ivya has spent centuries roaming the forests of Shyish and beyond, and she has triumphed over some of the most heinous beasts imaginable.

abilities.name: Shrieking Swarm
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: Wherever Iyva goes, a flight of screeching bats accompanies her.

abilities.name: Total Dominance
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **MONSTERS** while they are within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: With a swift and precise gesture, Ivya exerts her powerful influence over nearby monsters.

abilities.name: First of the Vyrkos
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **Radukar the Wolf**, **Radukar the Beast**, **Ivya Volga**, **Lady Annika** and **Kritza** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Belladamma is the matriarch of the Vyrkos bloodline, and she commands their conquests with calculating efficiency.

abilities.name: Under a Killing Moon
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **Dire Wolves** units wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons (including **Companion** weapons).
• The targets can ignore the effect of the ‘Beast’ ability.
abilities.lore: Beneath the light of a blood moon, Volga’s wolves attack with mad-eyed ferocity.

abilities.name: Wolfguard
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Dire Wolves** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Dire Wolves** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Belladamma’s lupine allies will unthinkingly sacrifice themselves to protect their savage mistress.

abilities.name: Starving Nightmare
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **lying in wait**.

Effect: Set up this unit wholly within enemy territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Unable to contain her hunger any longer, Lady Annika springs forth from hiding, eager to glut herself on the blood of the foe.

abilities.name: Supernatural Speed
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **lying in wait**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: Lady Annika’s near-permanent state of starvation drives her ahead of the main battlelines, ready to pounce as soon as prey draws near.

abilities.name: Kiss of the Blade Proboscian
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that was allocated any damage points inflicted by this unit’s combat attacks this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: This pitted and corroded blade should not endure – and yet, it does. The same cannot be said for anything scratched by its mouldering point.

abilities.name: The Verminous Court
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then pick an artefact of power that the target has.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.
abilities.lore: Kritza believes himself an appreciator of the finer things in undeath, and his rodent servants are adept in snatching away trinkets and treasures for his collection.

abilities.name: Scurrying Retreat
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: Just when a foe has him cornered, Kritza transfigures into a swarm of scurrying rats, only to rematerialise elsewhere and drive his blade into an enemy’s back.

abilities.name: Strike At The Heart
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s **Templar Weapons** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Focusing upon their own cursed hunger, the Vampire Lord stokes the predatory urges of a formation of Blood Knights, whose lances and blades strike with great precision and force as they impact with the foe.

abilities.name: 'For Glory! For Blood!'
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll the charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability. Then, before the charge move is made, you can pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of this unit and has not used a **CHARGE** ability this turn to be the target. If this unit charges, then, immediately after the **CHARGE** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target this phase.
abilities.lore: The Vampire Lord and their retinue of favoured knights charge into the fray, driving deep into the enemy lines.

abilities.name: Sanguine Blur
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy non-**HERO** units and more than 3" from all enemy **HEROES**.
abilities.lore: By the time this vampire’s prey notices the crimson streak heading towards them, it is far too late.

abilities.name: Scrying Pool
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, you can pick another friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit that has not used a command this phase to use the ‘Redeploy’ command immediately after the first has been resolved (this is an exception to Commands, 1.2). No command point is spent the second time that command is used.
abilities.lore: Within this pool of shimmering gore, the vampire foresees the shape of the battle to come.

abilities.name: Tactical Insight
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The vampire and their acolytes employ their divinatory abilities to manipulate and aid their undying servants.

abilities.name: A Promising Concoction
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **VAMPIRE** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The gory contents of the Coven Throne’s scrying bowl can be consumed by its riders and other vampires nearby, giving them a flush of power.

abilities.name: The Reliquary
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit is set up for the first time, place a **stored energy dice** beside it with the ‘1’ facing up. Each time a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this unit, increase the value of the **stored energy dice** beside this unit by 1 (to a maximum of 6).
abilities.lore: When the amethyst magics that thrum through a Mortis Engine reach a crescendo, its Corpsemaster custodian can unleash them as a lethal bow wave of power.

abilities.name: Nexus of Death Energy
abilities.description: Effect: When a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit is picked to be the target of the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability, add D3 to the number of damage points that can be healed or the combined Health characteristic of models that can be returned.
abilities.lore: Mortis Engines are constructed around the remains of a slain Necromancer, who acts as a locus for the magics of the underworlds.

abilities.name: Wave of Power
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the value of this unit’s **stored energy dice**. Then, change the value of the **stored energy dice** back to 1.
abilities.lore: With arms held aloft, the Corpsemaster discharges the energy stored within the Mortis Engine, searing the life force from those nearby.

abilities.name: Vanhel's Danse Macabre
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The undead are filled with magical energy that causes them to jerk forwards and attack with tireless, unnatural speed.

abilities.name: Undead Minions
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Necromancers are obsessed with staving off death and will sacrifice any number of their resurrected servants to protect themselves.

abilities.name: Ancient Barrow Curse
abilities.description:
Effect: If an attack made with this unit’s **King’s Relic Weapon** scores a critical hit, the target unit becomes **cursed** for the rest of the battle. Subtract 1 from save rolls for **cursed** units even if this unit has been destroyed.

**Designer’s Note**: *Multiple enemy units can become cursed by this ability but the same enemy unit cannot become cursed more than once.*
abilities.lore: The weapons of the most powerful Wight Kings leave a scar on the soul that causes the victim to slowly crumble to dust.

abilities.name: Immortal Conqueror
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within enemy territory.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units while they are wholly within 6" of that objective or terrain feature.
abilities.lore: A mighty general in life, in undeath, the endless need to wage war and conquer the lands of the living lingers on in this ancient wight as a thirst that can never be quenched.

abilities.name: King of Shambling Bones
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: In the presence of their sovereign, the footsoldiers of the Deathrattle kingdoms assume a sliver of their former warlike vigour.

abilities.name: Ancient Strategies
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Death does not rob a Wight King of their strategic genius, and they direct their undead thralls with great skill.

abilities.name: Royal Companions
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Mounted Wight Lords fight accompanied by their most skilled cavaliers, tearing through enemy battlelines.

abilities.name: Lord of Trampling Bones
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The knights who ride alongside a Wight Lord will be the most trusted and skilful of all their housecarls.

abilities.name: Creed of the Askurga Renkai
abilities.description:
Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy **MONSTERS** that target this unit.

Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by this unit that target enemy **MONSTERS**.
abilities.lore: Faithful to the teachings of ancient masters long slain, Trueblades test themselves against the most powerful adversaries, feasting solely on monstrous blood to bolster their strength and speed.

abilities.name: Gut-wrenching Howl
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit’s **Curseblood** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The howl of a Curseblood resounds with the force of long-repressed bloodlust finally finding release, staggering even the bravest souls.

abilities.name: Guardians of the King
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HEROES** are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: The Barrow Guard stand alongside the liege lord to whom they are bound.

abilities.name: Knights of the King
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY HEROES** are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Buried alongside their liege in ancient times, these deathly knights are still bound by arcane ward and ancient oath to ride into battle at their side.

abilities.name: Cursed To Rise Once More
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: You can return 1 slain model to this unit.
abilities.lore: Necrotic flames wreathe the shattered remains of an undead knight, compelling them to rejoin the battle.

abilities.name: Riders of Ruin
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.
abilities.lore: Blood Knights trample clean over lesser foes to strike at more worthy challengers.

abilities.name: Trampled to Dust
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Infantrymen who find themselves in the Blood Knights’ path are crushed beneath the hooves of their Nightmare steeds.

abilities.name: Locus of Undeath
abilities.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by other friendly **DEADWALKERS** units have **Crit (Auto-wound)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Corpse Carts are wellsprings of necromantic power that bestow greater vigour upon the resurrected corpses of the freshly slain.

abilities.name: Mindless Ferocity
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Heedless of pain and knowing nothing of fear, Deadwalker Zombies are relentless in their efforts to slay the foe, and they will continue to hack, claw and bite even as they meet their final end.

abilities.name: Skeleton Legion
abilities.description: Effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.
abilities.lore: As necromantic energies blanket the battlefield, long-dead warriors stagger to their feet once more, eye sockets aglow with killing light.

abilities.name: On The Hunt
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
abilities.lore: Unlike most undead, Dire Wolves have lost almost none of the swiftness they possessed in life and are forever hungry for warm flesh.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Fleet and Fell
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Borne swiftly upon huge, tattered wings, Fell Bats are able to swoop down upon and break away from their prey with impunity, their frenzied flapping making it difficult to pin them down.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Death on Tattered Wings
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **high above the battlefield**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The Revenant Draconith circles above the arrayed armies, eye sockets aglow with unholy energy.

abilities.name: Red Ruin
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, resolve the following effects:
•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
•  **Heal (X)** this unit where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
•  This unit can be removed from the battlefield and set up in reserve **high above the battlefield**.
abilities.lore: Tearing free of the press with talons and teeth, the Revenant Draconith leaves a trail of gory destruction behind as it takes to the skies once more, searching for fresh prey.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Loathsome Descent
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **high above the battlefield**.

Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Revenant Draconith plunges into battle with a roar, slamming into its prey with bone-shattering force.

abilities.name: Death's Descent
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Vargheists swoop down upon their victims from the sky, suddenly overwhelming them in a flurry of claws and fangs.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Brimming with Rancour
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target cannot end moves made as part of a non-**CHARGE MOVE** ability within **X**" of this unit, where **X** is equal to your current **fury level**.
abilities.lore: The Revenant Draconith turns towards a foe, the witchlights of its eyes flickering. Radiating pure malevolence, the enemy dares not approach its mouldering form.

abilities.name: Volatile Animus
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Retaliatory Posture***: For the rest of the turn:
• Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
• Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks, including attacks made with **Companion** weapons, that target an enemy unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this phase.

***Unrelenting Ferocity***: For the rest of the turn:
• Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s attacks.
• Add 1 to the Rend and Damage characteristics of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this phase
abilities.lore: The furious energies of Aqshy combine with the forces animating the Revenant Draconith to make it highly unpredictable.

abilities.name: Nightmare's Miasma
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The strange curse of the Vengorians sees shining blades and hallowed relics crumble and patinate in their presence.

abilities.name: Indignant Outburst
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, gain 1 **rage dice**.
abilities.lore: Filled with self-loathing and seething resentment, once the Vengorian Lord has a target for their simmering ire, they let their outrage boil over.

abilities.name: Frenzied Surge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: You can pick another visible friendly non-**HERO SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** or **MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: This unit and the target (if any) can move up to **X**+D3", where **X** is your **fury level**. They can move through enemy models and the combat ranges of enemy units during that move and must end that move in combat.

If you picked a target, after moving, this unit and the target must be in combat with the same enemy unit.
abilities.lore: As the Vengorian Lord tears through the press of combat to sate their desperate hunger, nearby undead find themselves swept along by their rabidity.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Ghorrakos’s Horns and Hooves** is 4.

abilities.name: The Curse of Stone
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit, then pick a second point on the battlefield within 9" of the first point. Draw a line between the caster and the first point, and between the first and second points. Each enemy unit the lines pass across is a target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Rumbling with laughter, Taar channels his curse into a billowing wave of power, seeing enemies gradually overcome with creeping petrification.

abilities.name: Peerless Among Daemonsmiths
abilities.description:
Effect: Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP - Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2 -** Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3 -** Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS, PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Urak Taar carries with him ancient knowledge said to have been imparted upon him by Hashut himself. Such closely guarded secrets grant him arcane mastery otherwise unheard of among daemonsmiths.

abilities.name: Pitiless Trampling
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance up to the value of the roll. During that move, this unit can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Taar contemptuously crashes through all those he considers inferior without even a sidewards glance.

abilities.name: Master of Daemonic Power
abilities.description: Effect: Remove up to 3 **daemonic power points** in total from any combination of friendly units wholly within 18" of this unit. Then, allocate them to a different friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit wholly within 18" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Taar is ancient and learned beyond measure and he can control the ebb and flow of the daemonic energy coursing through his army at will.

abilities.name: Immolating Presence
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
abilities.lore: With a beat of its wings and a snort of its nostrils, an Infernal Taurus unleashes a wave of daemonic heat.

abilities.name: Unholy Stampede
abilities.description:
Effect: While a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT CAVALRY** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:

•  That unit can use a **RETREAT** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: An Infernal Taurus inevitably forms the horn-tip of Hashut’s trampling hosts.

abilities.name: Daemonic Resilience
abilities.description:
Effect: Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2 -** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3 -** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS, PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Horns and Hooves** is 4.

abilities.name: Stoked Fanaticism
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit each phase while it is wholly within 6" of this unit. Add 6" to the range of this ability for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.
abilities.lore: Better to endure grievous wounds unflinching, so say the Zharrdron, than falter under the gaze of Hashut’s hateful priests.

abilities.name: Extract Power
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective, a **Place of Power**, or a terrain feature and that objective, **Place of Power** or terrain feature has a friendly desolation token, give this unit 1 ritual point.
abilities.lore: The hateful chanting of Hashut’s priesthood rips energy from the realms.

abilities.name: Molten Mending
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINE** wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target. Add 6" to the range of this ability for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.

Effect: **Heal (D3+X)** the target, where **X** is the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has.
abilities.lore: A learned Daemonsmith can suture ensorcelled plate and stoke the daemon furnaces anew.

abilities.name: 'Fight, You Scum!"
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Despot demands a tireless, pitiless aggression from their underlings.

abilities.name: Black-hearted Conqueror
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit. Add 6" to the range of this ability for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.
abilities.lore: Those sworn to serve beneath a Despot must offer them conquest and tribute or suffer the consequences…

abilities.name: Crush the Unworthy
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for each **daemonic power point** it has.
abilities.lore: The raw arrogance of the Bull Centaurs sees them crash through foes with wanton abandon.

abilities.name: Zealous Counter-Attack
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Counter-charge’ command for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Anointed Sentinels are furious, eager combatants that use their sheer size to meet charging armies head on.

abilities.name: Crush the Unworthy
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for each **daemonic power point** it has.
abilities.lore: The raw arrogance of the Bull Centaurs sees them crash through foes with wanton abandon.

abilities.name: Bull-Charge
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. Add the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has to each roll. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The galloping charge of the Bull Centaurs tramples lesser beings beneath their hooves.

abilities.name: Daemonic Strength
abilities.description:
Effect: For each **daemonic power point** this unit has:
•  Add 1" to its Move characteristic.
•  Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons.
abilities.lore: When empowered with a surplus of daemonic energy, Dominator Engines are made faster and deadlier still.

abilities.name: Engine of Domination
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat with any enemy **HEROES**, it can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the phase and can only be picked to use a second **FIGHT** ability if it is still in combat with any enemy **HEROES**.
abilities.lore: Enemy champions are frozen in dread by this daemon engine’s glare before being pulverised by its cursed mauls.

abilities.name: Daemonic Strength
abilities.description:
Effect: For each **daemonic power point** this unit has:
•  Add 1" to its Move characteristic.
•  Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons.
abilities.lore: When empowered with a surplus of daemonic energy, Dominator Engines are made faster and deadlier still.

abilities.name: All Must Burn!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick 2 or more visible enemy units within 8" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Immolation Cannons** for each unit picked to be the target of this ability, but each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, it must target each of those units with at least 3 of its attacks.
abilities.lore: Those who approach a Dominator earn but one end – death by unclean fire.

abilities.name: Hungering Flames
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit's **Hashu-Zharr Rockets** is 5 if the target is a **MONSTER** or a **WAR MACHINE**.
abilities.lore: The alchemical Hashu-Zharr flames yearn to consume. The more obstinate the prey, the better.

abilities.name: Watch Them Burn
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit and all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has for each other enemy unit within the combat range of the target of this unit's shooting attacks. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the enemy unit being rolled for.
abilities.lore: To be in the vicinity of a Hashu-Zharr rocket as it strikes its target is to risk a fiery, agonising demise.

abilities.name: Calculated Trajectory
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target an enemy unit with 5 or more models that is more than 12" from this unit.
abilities.lore: The warhosts of the Chaos duardin revel in overwhelming their foes with excessive, punishing firepower.

abilities.name: Ruinous Bombardment
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
