abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this turn and all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, that enemy unit is the target.

Then, you can pick a number of enemy units within 6" of the target equal to the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has to be additional targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, that unit cannot use commands until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Those who survive the initial unmaking wave of raw Chaos energy laid down by a Tormentor Bombard are left addled and disoriented.

abilities.name: Manglers of Metal
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.
abilities.lore: The weapons of the Zharrdron can be infernally empowered until they burn and blast clean through armour.

abilities.name: Hateful Hail
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this turn and all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, that enemy unit is the target.

Effect: Roll a dice and add the number of enemy models in the target unit slain by attacks made by this unit this turn. If the result is 6+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Carnage unfolds in the wake of a Grizmalok salvo, suppressing even the most rampant aggression.

abilities.name: Manglers of Metal
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.
abilities.lore: The weapons of the Zharrdron can be infernally empowered until they burn and blast clean through armour.

abilities.name: Scorched Remains
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this turn and all of its attacks targeted the same enemy **INFANTRY** unit, that enemy unit is the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract an amount equal to the roll from the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The grim aftermath left behind by the Helsmiths’ flamehurlers is enough to shake even the most stolid warrior to their very core.

abilities.name: Sacred Gongs
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Gong Carriers** are tokens. There is 1 **Gong Carrier** for every **MUSICIAN** in this unit. If this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, as a reaction, you can remove a **Gong Carrier** to make an additional rally roll of D6.
abilities.lore: Borne by straining hobgrots, these gongs are holy relics to the servants of Hashut.

abilities.name: Disciplined March
abilities.description: Effect: When making run rolls for this unit, if you roll a 1-3, you can use a value of 4 instead.
abilities.lore: The warriors of Hashut march with fell purpose in the name of their dark deity.

abilities.name: Daemonic Resilience
abilities.description:
Effect: Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2 -** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3 -** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS**, **PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.

abilities.description:
Effect: Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.

**3 -** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS**, **PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.

abilities.name: Conquered Lands
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is contesting an objective you control, pick a friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, give the target 1 **daemonic power** point.

**Designer’s Note:** *You cannot make more than one roll for each objective in each turn regardless of how many friendly units with this ability are contesting that objective.*
abilities.lore: In desolating the lands they seize and garrison, the Infernal Cohorts extract a fell power.

abilities.name: Sacred Gongs
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Gong Carriers** are tokens. There is 1 **Gong Carrier** for every **MUSICIAN** in this unit. If this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, as a reaction, you can remove a **Gong Carrier** to make an additional rally roll of D6.
abilities.lore: Borne by straining hobgrots, these gongs are holy relics to the servants of Hashut.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Horns and Hooves** is 4.

abilities.name: Daemonic Resilience
abilities.description:
Effect: Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2 -** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3 -** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS, PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.

abilities.name: Leech Realm-Magic
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: • Add 1 to casting rolls and unbinding rolls for this unit until the start of your next turn.

• You can pick an objective or terrain feature that has a friendly **desolation token** and that this unit is contesting. If you do so, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle, then remove that **desolation token** from the battlefield. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: The Daemonsmith rips arcane energies from a nearby ley line. The more devastated the land around them, the more power they can drain.

abilities.name: Calamitous Shockwave
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll is lower than your **fury level**, for the rest of the turn:

• The target cannot use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability.
• When resolving the damage sequence for the target, your opponent cannot spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: Rearing up, the Infernal Taurus slams its hooves into the ground, causing the earth around it to buckle and staggering nearby foes.

abilities.name: Zealous Acolytes
abilities.description:
Effect: • Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is contesting an objective you do not control.
• Add 10 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective you control.
abilities.lore: Those who disturb the Anointed Sentinels as they protect or claim Hashut’s sacred ground quickly discover their mistake.

abilities.name: Daemonic Resilience
abilities.description:
Effect: Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP Effect**
**1** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS**, **PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.

abilities.name: Skarbrand's Rage
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, or if it did not use a **FIGHT** ability last turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability apply to this unit.
abilities.lore: Skarbrand’s infamous fury cannot be quenched. Attacking him only serves to stoke his anger.

abilities.name: Roar of Total Rage
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll either 3 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of damage points this unit has. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: When Skarbrand roars, heads explode and blood boils in the veins of his victims.

abilities.name: Inescapable Wrath
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: No one is safe from Skarbrand’s rampages.

weapons.name: Mighty Axe of Khorne and Bloodflail

abilities.name: Wrathful Dominance
abilities.description: Effect: Add I to hit rolls for this unit's attacks that target an enemy **HERO.**
abilities.lore: Bloodthirsters of the Third Circle establish their battlefield superiority by hunting down the enemy's strongest champions.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Mighty Axe of Khorne and Bloodflail** is 4.

abilities.name: Vengeance of Khorne
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 8 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Wrath of Khorne Bloodthirsters deliver destruction to those who draw the ire of the War God.

abilities.name: Commander Of Tyrants
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly non-**UNIQUE BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Daemons of lesser rank are compelled to follow the orders of these bellowing greater daemons.

abilities.name: Outrageous Carnage
abilities.description: Effect: Each time an attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 8" of it after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved (and continue the attack sequence).
abilities.lore: Where a Great Axe of Khorne strikes, lashes of flame erupt from the split earth to annihilate those nearby.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Axe of Khorne** is 3.

abilities.name: Shattering Charge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is **INFANTRY**, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on it.
abilities.lore: A Bloodthirster of Insensate Rage is an avatar of supreme carnage upon the battlefield, shattering formations with the force of its descent.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Mighty Axe of Khorne** is 4 .

abilities.name: Ensnaring Lash
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is in combat with this unit when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability:

• It must pick this unit to be the target of the pile-in move (Core Rules, 15.3).
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability against this unit.
abilities.lore: The Lash of Khorne wraps around an enemy, stripping flesh as they try to pull away.

abilities.name: Beckon The Hunt
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for the target, roll 1 additional dice, to a maximum of 3, and discard 1 dice of your choice.
abilities.lore: The air shudders and convulses with each crack of the Bloodthirster's whip as it drives those in its shadow to bring slaughter and bloodshed in the name of Khorne.

abilities.name: The Eternal Duel
abilities.description: Effect: If an enemy **HERO** had any damage points allocated to it by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that **HERO** was destroyed this turn, **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points this unit has.
abilities.lore: Skulltaker relishes single combat with the strongest fighters in existence. Claiming their skulls only stokes his hunger for even greater challenges.

abilities.name: Heroes' Bane
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** but all of its combat attacks must target that enemy **HERO.**
abilities.lore: Khorne’s eternal champion seeks out the worthiest of foes and demands they face him in single combat.

abilities.name: Drawn By Blood
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield in combat with the target and not in combat with any other enemy units.
abilities.lore: Skulltaker stalks the greatest heroes in the Mortal Realms, often appearing in the midst of battle to slay them before they can strike back.

abilities.name: The Blood Must Flow
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Bloodletters** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by this unit and that friendly **Bloodletters** unit.
abilities.lore: Rallied by bloody example, Khorne’s lesser daemons leap into combat.

abilities.name: Offering of Blood
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add 1 to this unit's power level, to a maximum of 2.
abilities.lore: A Blood Throne is a sanctified altar of Khorne.

abilities.name: Blood Marked
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS.**
abilities.lore: The gore sigils on the Blood Throne protect it from enemy magics.

abilities.name: Prey of the Blood God
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Pick an enemy **HERO** to be this unit's quarry. You can pick a **HERO** in reserve.
abilities.lore: Karanak hunts those who have earned the Blood God’s ire.

abilities.name: First of the Pack
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Flesh Hounds** unit, add 2 to charge rolls for this unit. In addition, while any friendly **Flesh Hounds** units are wholly within 12" of this unit, they can ignore the effect of the ‘Beast’ ability.
abilities.lore: Where the Hound of Vengeance hunts, his bestial kin are sure to follow in pursuit, empowered by Karanak’s single-minded fury.

abilities.name: Stalk The Prey
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit’s quarry is on the battlefield, pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Flesh Hounds** unit to be the targets.

Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield more than 6" from this unit’s quarry and more than 9" from all other enemy units. If picked to be a target, the unit of **Flesh Hounds** must also be set up wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Karanak’s intended quarry is relentlessly and mercilessly run to ground.

abilities.name: 'Bring Me Their Skull!'
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **BLOODBOUND INFANTRY HERO** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Axe held aloft, this warlord orders one of his Gorechosen forward.

abilities.name: Lord of the Bloodbound
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly **BLOODBOUND INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: With bellowed commands and sworn vows of bloodshed, this mighty warlord commands their warriors to charge down the enemy.

abilities.name: Icon of the Blood God
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly **BLOODBOUND** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
abilities.lore: The massive brass-and-bone icons hefted by the Bloodsecrators inspire the Bloodbound to fight until their last, gore-flecked breath.

abilities.name: Rage of Khorne
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly **BLOODBOUND** units' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Bloodsecrator slams his banner into the ground, flooding the battlefield with the violent energies of Khorne’s hellish domain.

abilities.name: Whipped To Fury
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO BLOODBOUND** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The ferocious bite of a Bloodstoker’s lash reminds every Khorne follower of the bloody dues their master expects.

abilities.name: Desecrating Blood Runes
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, add I to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BLOODBOUND** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.
abilities.lore: The Ritualist carves blasphemous runes into the earth with their gore-slickened dagger, bringing down a rain of gore that drives Khorne’s faithful into a frenzy.

abilities.name: Tempered By Fury
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **BLOODBOUND HERO** within 8" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Until the horns for battle are sounded, Skullgrinders are known to work on their craft ceaselessly, tempering the weapons of their fellow warriors so that they glow red-hot with the rage of Khorne.

abilities.name: Bone-crushing Strikes
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target’s Control characteristic, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Larger beasts feel the full brunt of the Skullgrinder’s anvil as it crashes into their flank, shattering ribs and sending them sprawling.

abilities.name: Scorn of Sorcery
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: Slaughterpriests share their god’s hatred of sorcery and those who use it.

abilities.name: Blood Sacrifice
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) within this unit's combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit gains 1 ritual point.
abilities.lore: A Slaughterpriest knows better than any that Khorne cares not from where the blood flows…

abilities.name: Killer of Kings
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit and **MANIFESTATION** in combat with this unit to be a target.

Effect: Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model from that unit is slain or, if the target is a **MANIFESTATION,** it is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: A Deathbringer slays without pause or relent.

abilities.name: Trophies of Glorious Deaths
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 8" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On an 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost. This reaction cannot be used more than once per command.
abilities.lore: The sight of mighty champions reduced to nothing more than a Deathbringer's grisly trophies is enough to make the staunchest warrior baulk and falter.

abilities.name: Ceaseless Violence
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 3". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: As heads roll and blood flows, these daemons become more desperate to partake in the slaughter.

abilities.name: Crushing Onslaught
abilities.description:
Effect: If the unmodified charge roll for this unit is 8+:

• For the rest of the phase, this unit can pass through models in enemy units.
• Enemy **CAVALRY** units passed through by this unit in this phase cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The crushing mass and stamping hooves of Khorne's Juggernauts are a threat to all in their path.

abilities.name: Gruesome Bombardment
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by a **SHOOT** ability used by this unit, subtract 3 from that enemy unit’s control score for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Piercing laughter and growls erupt from the Skull Cannon’s jaws before its grisly missiles strike home – a salvo that can shatter the will.

abilities.name: Grind Their Bones, Seize Their Skulls
abilities.description: Effect: If any enemy models are slain by a **FIGHT** ability used by this unit, after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, this unit can immediately use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase.
abilities.lore: Enemy skulls shorn by the Bloodletters atop the Skull Cannon are used as fiery munitions.

abilities.name: Hunters of Mystics
abilities.description:
Effect: If the casting roll for an enemy **WIZARD** within 12" of this unit contains 2 or more results of 1 or 2, the spell is miscast.

If the chanting roll for an enemy **PRIEST** within 12" of this unit is an unmodified 2, the prayer fails and its effect is not resolved. In addition, your opponent cannot give that **PRIEST** any ritual points for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: The terrible baying and howling of Flesh Hounds inspires an instinctive, primal fear in those attuned to the arcane or the divine, making it difficult for them to focus on their spells and rituals.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Pack Hunters
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH HOUNDS** unit or a friendly **Karanak,** this unit's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
abilities.lore: The unearthly howls of Flesh Hounds send these killers into a blood-mad frenzy that sees them rip up and bite their enemies like a pack of dogs.

abilities.name: The Scent of Blood
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: These savage warriors roam ahead of the advancing army, seeking out the enemy so that they can be the first to draw blood.

abilities.name: Feast Upon Their Bones
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy non-**MONSTER** units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The nightmarish sight of a Khorgorath crunching upon the bones of their allies is enough to send enemy ranks into a frenzy of panic.

abilities.name: Horrific Predators
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Khorgoraths are nightmarish beasts, given form only to harvest skulls.

abilities.name: No Respite
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is contesting an objective you do not control, it has **WARD (5+).**
abilities.lore: Blood Warriors excel in the wild melee of battle, preferring to take the fight to key points in the enemy defences where the slaughter will be most prevalent.

abilities.name: Blood For The Blood God!
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: A howling mass of Bloodreavers is never more dangerous than when seized by the frenzy of the charge.

abilities.name: Slaughterous Charge
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The crushing mass and stamping hooves of Khorne’s Juggernauts are a threat to all in their path.

abilities.name: Crimson Haze
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **BLOODBOUND** units, excluding **Wrathmongers** units, while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: A frenzy-inducing cloud of blood and gore fills the air wherever Wrathmongers swing their flails.

abilities.name: Bloodfury
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 3" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Both players roll off. If you win the roll-off, pick a melee weapon that the target is armed with. Your opponent must pick a visible unit in their army within 3" of the target (they can pick the target's own unit, and even if it is a single-model unit).

Your opponent must resolve combat attacks for the target using the melee weapon you picked against the unit they picked.
abilities.lore: The maddening blood-vapour that surrounds Wrathmongers can plunge their foes into a self-destructive rage.

abilities.name: Trial of Skulls
abilities.description: Effect: Add 8 to this unit's control score while it is in combat.
abilities.lore: The looming threat of failing the Trial of Skulls lends the Skullreapers a manic determination in battle,for nothing could be worse than the horrible consequences should they appear weak in the eyes of their wrathful god.

abilities.name: Drawn to Slaughter
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You or your opponent declared the 'Eruption of Fury' ability for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Return 1 slain model to this unit. If your opponent declared that ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability and the unit using the ability is in combat with this unit, return 3 slain models to this unit instead.
abilities.lore: As battle rages and pent-up wrath is explosively unleashed, more Bloodletters rip through the veil between worlds, keen to join the massacre.

abilities.name: Only The Worthy
abilities.description:
Effect: The following cumulative effects apply depending on the number of models in this unit that are slain.

**1+** Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.
**4+** Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
**8+** Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
**16+** Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons and this unit’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
abilities.lore: As the weakest are culled from the Blood Warriors’ ranks, the survivors receive Khorne’s dark blessings, granting them ever greater ferocity and strength.

abilities.name: The Eye of Sheerian
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. This roll replaces the priority roll of the next battle round. On a 1-3, your opponent must take the first turn of that battle round. On a 4-6, you must take the first turn of that battle round. This ability cannot be used if there is an enemy **Archaon** on the battlefield.
abilities.lore: Torn from the corpse of a mighty dragon, this artefact grants Archaon visions of future events.

abilities.name: The Slayer of Kings
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, if the unmodified wound roll for 2 or more attacks made with **The Slayer of Kings** that target the same **HERO** is 6, that **HERO** is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: This ancient daemonblade thirsts for the souls of champions and warlords.

abilities.name: Three-headed Titan
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Filth-spewer:*** Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit and roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in that unit, to a maximum of 7. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

***Skull-gorger:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and roll a dice. If the roll exceeds that unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in that unit is slain and you can **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is that unit’s Health characteristic.

***Spell-eater:*** Pick a **MANIFESTATION** within 12" of this unit and roll a dice. On a 2+, it is banished and removed from play. In addition, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit that summoned it.
abilities.lore: The greater daemons consumed by Dorghar imbue the Everchosen’s steed with unlimited power.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Dorghar’s Claws and Tails** is 4.

abilities.name: Roar of Domination
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Thanatorg is quick to put potential usurpers of Abraxia’s power in their place.

abilities.name: Blood of Molten Varanite
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice each time a damage point inflicted by a combat attack is allocated to this unit. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Any who wound the Thanatorg risk being splashed by its highly mutative blood.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **the Thanatorg’s Claws and Fangs** is 4.

abilities.name: Gorbolga the Accurs'd
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:

***1 - Uncontrollable Power:***
Allocate 1 damage point to this unit.

***2 - The Spear Slumbers:***
No effect.

***3-5 - White-hot Varanite:***
Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Gorbolga** for the rest of the turn.

***6 - Rampant Mutation:***
The effect of ‘White-hot Varanite’ applies and this unit’s **Gorbolga** has **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A ‘gift’ from the Everchosen, Gorbolga is a varanite spear that carries a potent mutative curse – but should its wielder’s will slip, they too will learn of its hunger…

abilities.name: Warlord of the First Circle
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly **Varanguard** unit uses the ‘Relentless Killers’ ability while it is wholly within 12" of this unit, that unit does not have **STRIKE-LAST** as a result of that ability.
abilities.lore: Abraxia commands the Swords of Chaos with relentless brutality.

abilities.name: The Dark Master
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use an ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that ability has no effect.
abilities.lore: Many puppets dance on Be’lakor’s infernal strings. Few realise as much until their fate is sealed.

abilities.name: Enfeeble Foe
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls from the target’s combat attacks.
• The target’s combat attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
abilities.lore: With a series of hissed incantations, Be’lakor instils visions of loss and despair in the minds of his enemies to drain them of their fighting spirit.

abilities.name: Shadow Form
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).
abilities.lore: Be’lakor can shift his physical form to be as insubstantial as the mists of Ulgu – and just as hard to land a telling blow upon.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Blade of Shadows** is 6.

abilities.name: Deadly Trap
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, that target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Dark Master delights in lethal reversals of expectation and fate.

abilities.name: Relentless Killers
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Varanguard have slaughtered foes beyond counting, butchering their way across the battlefields of the Mortal Realms without mercy.

abilities.name: Divert Realmgate
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Units set up this turn using this unit’s ‘Book of Profane Secrets’ ability can be set up wholly within 18" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units instead of the distances in the ability.
abilities.lore: Whispering fell incantations, a Gaunt Summoner can temporarily divert the path of a realmgate, allowing malefic Chaos entities to storm the battlefield.

abilities.name: Minions of the Silver Tower
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target.

Effect: The target is set up in reserve **in a Silver Tower**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The warped fortresses of the Gaunt Summoners are infested with their thrall hosts.

abilities.name: Book of Profane Secrets
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit **in a Silver Tower** to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Using this arcane tome, the Gaunt Summoner calls forth minions from their Silver Tower.

abilities.name: Minions of the Silver Tower
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target.

Effect: The target is set up in reserve **in a Silver Tower**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The warped fortresses of the Gaunt Summoners are infested with their thrall hosts.

abilities.name: Book of Profane Secrets
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit **in a Silver Tower** to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Using this arcane tome, the Gaunt Summoner calls forth minions from their Silver Tower.

abilities.name: Arcane Imprisonment
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the unmodified casting roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed. For the rest of the battle, that unit cannot be picked to be the target of an ability that allows a replacement unit to be set up.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners delight in banishing foes to their Silver Towers.

abilities.name: Veins of Black Lightning
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed.

Effect: Roll 2D6. Add 1 to the roll if a friendly **Be’lakor** is on the battlefield. On an 8+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Reborn in the Cursed Skies above the realms, Eternus’s soul is tethered to the Mortal Realms through the dark magics of his master; whenever he is struck down, a flash of black lightning sees him stand defiant once more.

abilities.name: Network of Spies
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the enemy unit is in combat with a friendly **Chaos Legionnaires** or **Chaos Furies** unit. On a 5+, that command has no effect. The command still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
abilities.lore: Eternus commands a legion of agents and operatives to ensure he is always one step ahead of his enemies.

abilities.name: Marshal of the Legions
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAEMON** or **Chaos Legionnaires** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Not only formidable combatants, Centaurion Marshals lead the forces of the First Prince into battle with an iron fist.

abilities.name: The Mounted Skulls of the Fallen
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has a **Trophy Rack**, its **Hellforged Weapons** also have **Anti‑HERO (+1 Rend)**.
abilities.lore: Some Daemon Princes revel in glory with each worthy foe slain by their hands.

abilities.name: Immortal Champion
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Those favoured enough to ascend to daemonhood are among the most deadly servants of the Ruinous Powers.

abilities.name: Airborne Horror
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has **Wings**, it has a Move characteristic of 10" and has **FLY**.
abilities.lore: Carried aloft by ragged leathery wings, this favoured champion of the Chaos Gods will bring ruin wherever they descend.

abilities.name: The Knights of Chaos
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIORS OF CHAOS CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: At the head of a charge, this Chaos Lord leads their cavalry to crush any foe before them.

abilities.name: Brutish Rampage
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick up to 3 enemy units within 1" of it to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: A charging Karkadrak is an almost unstoppable force, capable of smashing straight through even the most determined shieldwall.

abilities.name: Drive The Legions Forward
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly non-**HERO** non-**CAVALRY WARRIORS OF CHAOS** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Mounted atop a mighty Karkadrak, the Chaos Lord signals the charge.

abilities.name: Glory In Battle
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIORS OF CHAOS INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Under the command of their warlord, the warriors sworn to them waste no time in slaying the enemy.

abilities.name: Glory-seeker
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target **HEROES** or **MONSTERS**.
abilities.lore: To earn the favour of their patron, these formidable warriors ruthlessly hunt down enemy monsters and champions.

abilities.name: Oracular Visions
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice.

Effect: On a 3+, the target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: A sorcerer can temporarily bestow the gift of foresight upon their allies, helping them ward against enemy blows.

abilities.name: Myrmidon Rage
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is damaged, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Every wound inflicted on a Myrmidon only serves to stoke its rage further.

abilities.name: Pit Master
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Ogroid Theridons** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Myrmidons are given governance over the gladiatorial pits of the Varanspire, and all who have fought there willingly follow them into the fray.

abilities.name: Tribal Warleader
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DARKOATH INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: With strength and fierce purpose, the rulers of the Darkoath tribes lead those sworn to their banners into the fray to fulfil their oaths.

abilities.name: Oath of Murder
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit destroyed an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** this turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Darkoath Chieftains offer up the souls of enemy lords and champions in exchange for divine power.

abilities.name: Oath of Murder
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit destroyed an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** this turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Darkoath Chieftains offer up the souls of enemy lords and champions in exchange for divine power.

abilities.name: Cavalry Warleader
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly **DARKOATH CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Darkoath Chieftain leads the cavalry swiftly into the enemy ranks.

abilities.name: Oath of Supremacy
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is wholly within enemy territory and charged this phase, for the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **DARKOATH** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: By the will of the gods, this warrior leads her barbarous horde into the lands of the enemy, allowing none to oppose them.

abilities.name: Ruin-blessed Conqueror
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective that this unit is contesting.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, friendly **DARKOATH** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are contesting that objective.
abilities.lore: A Warqueen heeds the whispers of the gods, ravaging lands in their name and drawing their gaze onto her warrior hordes.

abilities.name: Oath of Bloodshed
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if any enemy **HEROES** were slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn.

Effect: Friendly **GUNNAR’S OATHSWORN** units have **WARD (4+)** for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Though he is contemptuous of the gods, Gunnar is still Darkoath; he is not so foolish as to reject their boons should they seek to reward his murder-making.

abilities.name: Carve a Path To Glory
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is in combat with an enemy **HERO**.

Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn. When using the second **FIGHT** ability, this unit must pick an enemy **HERO** to be the target of all of its attacks.
abilities.lore: Ruthless in battle, Gunnar Brand closes in on the enemy’s champions, claiming skulls and earning glory with each swing of his axes.

abilities.name: Swift As The Wind
abilities.description: Effect: Only critical hits score successful hits for shooting attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: Singri’s horsemanship is unrivalled by any of the Darkoath. She weaves deftly across the battlefield, avoiding enemy fire and loosing deadly accurate shots with her bow in return..

abilities.name: Uncanny Shot
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Singri’s Warbow** for attacks that target enemy units that are within 6" of a friendly **Gunnar Brand**.
abilities.lore: Gunnar Brand has been saved on more than one occasion by a well-placed arrow from Singri.

abilities.name: Withering Death
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Nadja spits a vile curse in the Dark Tongue, drawing unnatural shadows to coil around an enemy champion and sap their life force.

abilities.name: Broken Nadja
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit’s **Broken Nadja** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: Broken Nadja wields the energies of ruin itself through dark incantations.

abilities.name: Heralds of Ruination
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Paragons of the Dark Gods, Chaos Chosen cut a swathe through the enemy lines, leaving nothing but blood and ruin in their wake.

abilities.name: Impaling Charge
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its **Cursed Lances**.
abilities.lore: A charging Chaos Knight is capable of spitting several enemies at once with the point of their ensorcelled polearm.

abilities.name: Bringers of Desolation
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Rune-etched Weapons** while it is contesting an objective you control.
abilities.lore: Chaos Warriors fight with relentless ferocity in those places consecrated to the Dark Gods.

abilities.name: Sow Confusion
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: To the disciples of Be’lakor, subterfuge and lies are as keen as any blade.

abilities.name: Swift Death
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Chaos Chariots are at their most deadly on the charge, where their considerable bulk and bladed wheels can cause untold devastation.

abilities.name: Brutal Momentum
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit uses the ‘Power Through’ command, inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the target and add 3" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.
abilities.lore: The ferocity of Gorebeasts is terrible to behold as they carve a path of bloody destruction through the enemy ranks.

abilities.name: Unleashed Savagery
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Suppressing their savage spirit no more, these ferocious warriors hack at the foe in a bestial frenzy.

abilities.name: Glorious Death
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly **DARKOATH HEROES**, each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Ever keen to earn the favour of their tribe, when the eyes of the fiercest fighters are upon them, these warriors will not go down without a fight.

abilities.name: Oath of the Marauder
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this phase and the unmodified charge roll was 8+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s weapons for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: These bloodthirsty tribal warriors loudly declare vows of violence and slaughter as they race after their foes.

abilities.name: Swift Attackers
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: As they close in on the enemy at frightening speed, these skilled horsemen are nigh impossible to hit with missile fire.

abilities.name: Oath of the Raider
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this phase and is only in combat with 1 enemy unit, and that enemy unit is only in combat with this unit, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s weapons for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Before battle, Fellriders swear oaths to harry the enemy without mercy, showing no mercy to those stragglers who fall beneath their axes.

abilities.name: Oath of Conquest
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective you control that is wholly within enemy territory, this unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Heeding their Godspeaker’s proclamations, these warriors seek to earn glory by driving back the enemy.

abilities.name: Feed on Flesh
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a model (friendly or enemy) is slain within 12" of this unit, give this unit a **sacrifice point**, to a maximum of 6. If there are more than 1 friendly **Darkoath Wilderfiend** units within 12" of the slain model, only 1 of them can be given a **sacrifice point** for that slain model.
abilities.lore: Having been appeased with sacrificial blood, this creature may bestow dark blessings upon its kin.

abilities.name: Primal Sorcery
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Mind Shroud:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a number of dice equal to the number of **sacrifice points** this unit has. If any of the rolls are a 5+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

***Warping Balefire:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a number of dice equal to the number of **sacrifice points** this unit has. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

***Dark Might:*** **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of sacrifice points this unit has.

After applying the effect you picked, reset this unit’s **sacrifice points** to 0.
abilities.lore: Though bestial, Darkoath Wilderfiends possess innate powers of sorcery.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Aura of Mutation
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect below. If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH WIZARD**, you can roll 2 dice instead, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect below.

**1 - *Untouched***
No effect.

**2 - *Hideous Disfigurement***
Subtract 3 from the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

**3 - *Troggbrains***
The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

**4 - *Gift of Mutations***
Subtract 1" from the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the battle.

**5 - *Horrific Absorption***
Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. Then, **Heal (D6)** this unit.

**6 - *Transmogrification***
Pick any other effect.
abilities.lore: To stand near a Mutalith can have horrific consequences.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Betentacled Maw** is 8.

abilities.name: Mutant Regeneration
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.
abilities.lore: This unnatural abomination is invigorated by the raw power of Chaos.

abilities.name: Rampaging Charge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target unit is **INFANTRY**, double the amount of mortal damage inflicted.
abilities.lore: The Slaughterbrute crashes into the enemy’s ranks in a frenzy of destruction.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Razor-tipped Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Sigils of Domination
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS HERO** within this unit’s combat range to be this unit’s master.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, while this unit is within its master’s combat range:
• Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
• This unit can ignore the effects of the **Companion** weapon ability on its weapons.
abilities.lore: By carving runes of domination into a Slaughterbrute’s back and driving cursed blades of binding into its flesh, the monster’s will can be bound to a champion of Chaos.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Drawn to Power
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Daemon Prince**, you can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for this unit’s Move and Attacks characteristics.
abilities.lore: Even cursed with their hideous and twisted form, Chaos Spawn still covet the boons of the Dark Gods and are drawn to those most favoured by their patron.

abilities.name: Dominate Mind
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Sphiranx can manipulate the actions of its enemies with a simple glance.

abilities.name: Sneaky Little Devils
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: Chaos Furies are spiteful creatures that utterly loathe the idea of engaging in a fair fight, much preferring – where possible – to stab distracted enemies in the back.

abilities.name: Cursed Destroyers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature within 1" of this unit, then pick each other unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that terrain feature to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Once skilled masons, these creatures have been cursed by the Everchosen to now live only to destroy.

abilities.name: Crazed Flock
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.
abilities.lore: A flock of snapping, screeching Raptoryx is capable of swiftly bringing down any prey should they catch them unawares.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Ferocious Influence
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if this unit charged this turn. Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with **Companion** weapons used by friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS CAVALRY** and **WAR MACHINE** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
abilities.lore: When a Karkadrak enters a blood frenzy, other creatures are swept up in its bloody mania, ripping chunks of flesh from limbs and torsos and caving in skulls with their hooves.

abilities.name: Wrathful Abandon
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and a friendly non-**HERO WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can move a number of inches equal to your **fury level**. If a target was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat with all of the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move. It cannot move into combat with units it was not already in combat with at the start of that move.
abilities.lore: Imbued with the eager fury of battle, the Chaos Lord and their warriors are and swiftly fall upon their foes.

abilities.name: For the Glory of the Dark Gods
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the following cumulative effects apply depending on your **fury level**.

***1+ Riled***: This unit has **WARD (6+)**.

***4+ Seething***: This unit’s melee weapons have **Anti‐charge (+1 Rend)**.

***7 Enraged***: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** while it has not charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The more these warriors embrace the fervour within, the greater the favour that is bestowed upon them by the Ruinous Powers.

abilities.name: Scry the Filth
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARDS** while they are within 3" of this unit.
• Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIESTS** while they are within 3" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Globules of bloody mucus in Belga’s cauldron coalesce into misshapen masses that Belga uses to divine Nurgle’s will.

abilities.name: Ruptured Cysts
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible **DISEASED** enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each other **DISEASED** enemy unit within 3" of the target. If the chanting roll was 9+, you can also pick a friendly **PLAGUEBEARERS** unit within 12" of the target. For each enemy **INFANTRY** model slain by this ability this turn, you can return 1 slain model to that friendly unit.
abilities.lore: Belga intones a chant that triggers a chain reaction of agonising, pus-filled eruptions in the bodies of sickened foes.

abilities.name: Miasma of Pestilence
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that friendly unit have no effect.
abilities.lore: Bloab Rotspawned completes a complicated gesture in the air and a vile mist rises from the ground around his target.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Bilespurter’s Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Daemon Flies
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The whirling fly-storm that surrounds Bloab protects him from harm.

abilities.name: From the Tainted Earth
abilities.description:
Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 3" of:

• An objective or terrain feature that has a friendly **Pestilent Pollutant**, or

• A **POLLUTED** terrain feature (see Gelgus Pust’s warscroll), or
• An objective you control.
abilities.lore: Where the lands have been utterly contaminated, there can the Cankerborn manifest at will.

abilities.name: Utter Defilement
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit’s **Pestilent Pollutants** are tokens. This unit has 2 **Pestilent Pollutants**. Pick an objective or terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Place 1 of this unit’s **Pestilent Pollutants** next to the target. If both of this unit’s **Pestilent Pollutants** are already on the battlefield, pick 1 of them, remove it from the battlefield and place it next to the target instead.
abilities.lore: The Cankerborn corrupt the land around them until it is so saturated with toxins and pathogens as to be nigh unrecognisable.

abilities.name: Entropy Endures
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has 2 models and would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, 1 model in this unit is slain.
abilities.lore: Such is the Cankerborn’s resilience that they are almost impossible to banish back to the Garden.

abilities.name: Vile Poisons and Debilitating Toxins
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.

Effect: You and your opponent must roll off. Add this unit’s Control characteristic to your roll and the target’s Control characteristic to your opponent’s roll. If your roll is higher, apply the corresponding effect:

• If the target is a **HERO** or **MONSTER**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between your roll and your opponent’s roll.

• If the target is a non-**HERO** non-**MONSTER** unit, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
abilities.lore: Festus is a master-mixer of deadly potions and virulent concoctions.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Gathoblyt’s Fanged Maw** is 3.

abilities.name: The Leechlord's Curse
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: This unit gains 1 **leech point** for the rest of the battle. Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **CORE** ability or command, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any damage points were allocated to the target by this ability, **Heal (1)** this unit.
abilities.lore: The unfortunate victim finds themselves host to parasitic leeches that drain the vitality from their very soul.

abilities.name: Annelid Engorgement
abilities.description: Effect: For each enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn and was destroyed this turn, this unit gains D3 **leech points** for the rest of the battle. Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to this unit’s Control characteristic for each **leech point** it currently has.
abilities.lore: Gathoblyt swells as it gorges itself on the festering remnants of fallen warriors.

abilities.name: Bloated with Corruption
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is damaged, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Should a Great Unclean One be wounded, the noxious effluvia within its swollen body will burst forth in a flesh-melting spray.

abilities.name: Locus of Nurgle
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of this unit or a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Great Unclean calls upon Grandfather Nurgle to tear a rift in reality through which loathsome, foetid daemons can spill.

abilities.name: Plague Wind
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has the **DISEASED** keyword.
abilities.lore: With a satisfied belch, the greater daemon unleashes a gust of putrid air that smothers the battlefield.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Colossal Blight Weapons** is 3.

abilities.name: Flailing Tentacles
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Gutrot grabs his opponents with his melange of slimy tentacles, rendering them helpless as he swings his rusted axe.

abilities.name: Pestilential Beachhead
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **aboard the Slime Fleet**.

Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield, wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then set up every other friendly unit that is **aboard the Slime Fleet** on the battlefield wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 7" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: To the creak of rotting timbers and the waft of rancid brine, the Slime Fleet makes land.

abilities.name: Master of the Slime Fleet
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a regiment led by this unit to be the target if no units from that regiment have been deployed.

Effect: Each unit in the target regiment is set up in reserve **aboard the Slime Fleet**. Those units have now been deployed.
abilities.lore: Gutrot’s Slime Fleet haunts the oceans of the Mortal Realms, fighting alongside and transporting warriors that the Lord of Tentacles judges to share his aims.

abilities.name: Knell of Doom
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. If the target is within 6" of a friendly **Sloven Knights** unit, you can roll a D6 instead. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The ominous toll of the Harbinger's bell is enough to give pause to even the bravest warriors.

abilities.name: Omens of Decay
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Subtract twice the current battle round number from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, this ability affects all enemy units within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Harbingers of Decay are diseased prophets, able to divine omens through grisly rites and observing the spread of sickness.

abilities.name: Beast Handler
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Beast of Nurgle** unit that has been destroyed.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Horticulous is accompanied by romping packs of Beasts of Nurgle, who look to him like hounds do their master and whose foolishness he always forgives.

abilities.name: Cultivating the Garden of Nurgle
abilities.description: Effect: If there is no more than 1 friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield, you can set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.
abilities.lore: Wherever Horticulous slimes around in the Mortal Realms, daemonic foliage pokes through the cracks in reality and swiftly takes root.

abilities.name: Gnarlmaw Whisperer
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.
abilities.lore: With a little gentle coaxing, the daemonic trees of the Garden will uproot themselves and lumber to the Grand Cultivator’s side.

abilities.name: Vectors of Foulest Contagion
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Through the use of rancid corpse-totems and other such gifts from the Grandfather, a Lord of Afflictions spreads death wherever they travel.

abilities.name: Master of Rot Flies
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **PUSGOYLE BLIGHTLORDS** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets’ **Rot Fly’s Mouthparts and Sting** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Lord of Afflictions leads a swarm of Rot Flies that act as brutal linebreakers, using their sheer bulk to smash enemy formations asunder.

abilities.name: Festering Bulwark
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and a friendly **PUTRID BLIGHTKINGS**  unit within 3" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Heavy shield planted in the mud, a Lord of Blights orders their warriors brace for the enemy attack.

abilities.name: Thrice-ripened Death's Heads
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit or with a friendly **Plague Drones** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll D3. On 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: These blessed death’s heads are projectiles ripe with disease and hurled at incoming foes to spread the plagues festering within.

abilities.name: Lord of the Infected Legions
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **ROTSWORDS** units that did not charge this turn while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Under the rheumy gaze of a Lord of Plagues, Rotswords will repel those foolish enough to try to break their diseased ranks.

abilities.name: Sevenfold Slaughter
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ROTSWORDS** unit that did not charge this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s **Ruined Master-crafted Weapons** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Lord of Plagues drives their warriors to keep hacking at the foe until they are reduced to nothing more than twitching, filth-streaked offal.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Tripletongue’s Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Lord of Nurglings
abilities.description:
Effect: While any friendly **NURGLINGS**  units are wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to that **NURGLINGS**  unit each phase.
• That **NURGLINGS**  unit can ignore the effect of the ‘Beast’ ability.
abilities.lore: Nurglings follow their mortal champion into battle with boundless enthusiasm.

abilities.name: Gigantic Nurgling-kin
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is half the number of damage points this unit has (rounding up).
abilities.lore: Morbidex has come to resemble the Nurglings physically and has gained much of their unnatural resilience.

abilities.name: Tide of Nurglings
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **NURGLINGS**  units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is not in combat, it can move a number of inches equal to the roll but cannot end that move in combat.
• If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.
abilities.lore: Morbidex’s pox maggoth bellows out a gurgling roar that drives nearby swarms of Nurglings into a frenzy.

abilities.name: Grasping Tongue
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The massive pox maggoth Whippermaw lashes its tongue around its hapless victim, preparing to devour them.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Whippermaw’s Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Acid Ichor
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Whenever Orghotts’s flesh is cut open, a gout of daemonic ichor spews out with shocking force. Its vitriolic potency is enough to burn through steel and dissolve the flesh beneath.

abilities.name: Captain of the Plague Legions
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Plaguebearers** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Poxbringers lead their fellow Plaguebearers into battle and ensure that the orders of the Great Unclean Ones are followed to the letter.

abilities.name: Tainted Sorceries
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that was picked to be the target of a spell that was successfully cast by this unit this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Rotbringer Sorcerers hold that there is nothing they cannot corrupt.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
